  • Atuação em Pentests e testes de intrusão, com foco na identificação e mitigação de vulnerabilidades.

  • Experiência com análise de logs, forense digital, observabilidade e monitoramento.

  • Inteligência emocional para manter o equilíbrio diante de desafios e interações diversas, com empatia e autocontrole.

  • Analyze changes in Brazilian tax legislation and assess potential business impacts, providing recommendations for compliance.

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Law. Advanced degree or CPA certification preferred.
  • Solid experience in indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning;
  • Knowledge in Tax reform;
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and communication skills with different stakeholders;


Language:

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Como Senior DevOps Engineer na área de DTI da Sankhya, você terá a missão de contribuir significativamente com a evolução da nossa cultura de DevOps, elevando a maturidade de processos, ferramentas e práticas. Essa posição terá forte impacto estratégico na estabilidade, automação e governança dos nossos ambientes, sendo referência técnica e parceira das áreas de desenvolvimento, segurança e operações.


Se você busca desafios complexos, autonomia e a oportunidade de influenciar a arquitetura e as práticas de engenharia em escala, essa vaga é para você.



RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Diagnóstico e plano de ação para maturidade DevOps: mapear processos, ferramentas e práticas atuais, identificando gargalos e propondo um plano de evolução com prioridades claras para eficiência, automação e confiabilidade;
  • Estabilização e automação dos pipelines de CI/CD: puxar a revisão, padronização e automação de pipelines, garantindo versionamento, rastreabilidade e segurança das implantações, além de implementar práticas como blue/green deploy ou rollback automatizado;
  • Governança e confiabilidade dos ambientes: implementar processos e ferramentas que fortaleçam segurança, configuração e monitoramento, utilizando infraestrutura como código (ex.: Terraform), além de fomentar a cultura de observabilidade e resposta proativa a incidentes;
  • Apoiar tecnicamente o time de DevOps e promover boas práticas de engenharia em toda a organização;
  • Diagnosticar e solucionar problemas complexos de performance e disponibilidade em sistemas distribuídos.



REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Experiência sólida em arquitetura de sistemas distribuídos e escaláveis ;
  • Domínio de ferramentas de CI/CD e automação (Jenkins, GitLab, Ansible, Puppet, Chef, ArgoCD, etc.);
  • Vivência em infraestrutura como código (Terraform, CloudFormation ou similares);
  • Conhecimento avançado em linguagens de scripting/automação (Python, Ruby, Shell Script);
  • Linux avançado (obrigatório) e experiência com Windows Server;
  • Fundamentos de redes, protocolos e segurança ;
  • Experiência em cloud computing (AWS, GCP ou Azure) e boas práticas de otimização de custo/performance;
  • Containers e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes );
  • Experiência com monitoramento, logging e observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog ou similares).



Se você busca um desafio para liderar a evolução tecnológica de um dos maiores ERPs do país, com impacto direto na experiência de milhares de usuários, queremos te conhecer!

  • Sólida experiência em gestão de carteira de cliente , focando em relacionamento e fidelização.
  • Excelente habilidade de comunicação, negociação e persuasão.

Se você é movido(a) a desafios, adora vender e quer crescer junto com um grupo de comunicação de referência, essa vaga é para você!

Por favor, inclua "VAGA CONSULTOR DE VENDAS" no assunto do e-mail.


Estamos ansiosos para conhecer você!

description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


You’ll be working alongside our Lead Desktop Designer day-to-day, while also collaborating regularly with the larger design team, motion graphics team, and user acquisition team to bring ideas to life from wireframes to polished UIs. While the lead drives the vision, you’ll turn concepts into reality with speed, precision, and polish.   • Respect for dev workloads—your work should make their lives easier, not

  • Reliable, communicative, and fun to work with under pressure

  • Experience designing responsive layouts for desktop applications, with

  • Light working knowledge of HTML/CSS/JS (enough to understand
  • constraints)
  • Comfort using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Midjourney) for speed and
  • inspiration
  • Familiarity with accessibility and internationalization basics

description:
Sales Account Manager

Location: Brazil (Remote)


About the role:

As an Sales Account Manager , you will play a pivotal role in achieving sales targets and driving the growth of BSI America’s product and service offerings related to ISO standards and certifications. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who thrives in a target-driven environment and enjoys developing long-term relationships with clients.


In your day to day, you will be responsible for:

  • Drive Sales Growth : As a hunter in the sales field, develop and nurture relationships with existing clients while identifying and securing new business opportunities through prospecting and cold calling.
  • Consultative Selling : Engage with key decision-makers in small to midsize organizations to present and position BSI products and services, helping them meet ISO standards.
  • Pipeline Development : Identify and qualify new business leads, building a continuous sales pipeline to support long-term success.
  • Client Relationship Management : Foster strong relationships with clients, ensuring continuous business growth and repeat engagements.
  • Market Trend Identification : Stay ahead of industry trends, strategizing to capture new revenue generation opportunities.
  • Accurate Reporting : Provide timely and accurate sales reports, supporting business forecasting and strategy development.
  • Travel for Success : Travel to visit clients on a quarterly basis, building personal connections and furthering business opportunities.


To be successful in the role, you will have:

  • Sales Experience : At least four years of experience in sales.
  • Industry Knowledge : Familiarity with the certification industry and/or ISO standards is a plus, though not essential.
  • Exceptional Communication Skills : Strong ability to negotiate, influence, and build relationships with both internal teams and external clients.
  • Collaboration Mindset : Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and external partners.
  • Tech-Savvy : Experience with CRM tools like SAP and Salesforce is an advantage.
  • Valid Driver's License : Travel to client sites is required on a quarterly basis.


What we offer:

BSI offers a competitive total reward package, an independent and varied job in an international environment, flexible working hours, ongoing training and development with the inclusion of; 20-days annual leave, bank holidays, medical, dental, vision, and life insurance, short-term and long-term disability, maternal leave, paid parental leave, paid bereavement leave, learning and development opportunities, and a wide range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your lifestyle.


Do you believe the world deserves excellence?

We are proud to be the business improvement company for other organisations to become more sustainable and resilient and finally to inspire trust in their products, systems, services, and the world we live in.


Headquartered in London, BSI is the world's first national standards organization with more than 100 years of experience. We are a global partner for 86,000 companies and organizations in over 193 countries, offering development, auditing, certification, and training services, including innovative software solutions and cyber security expertise for all industries: from aerospace and automotive to food, construction, energy, healthcare, IT and trade sectors. Incorporated by Royal Charter, we’re truly impartial, and home to the ultimate mark of trust, the Kitemark.


Through our unique combination of consulting, training, assurance and regulatory services we bring solid and broad knowledge to every company.


D&I Policy

BSI is committed to ensuring the diversity of our workforce reflects that of our clients and the communities in which we operate. Our goal is to create a sense of belonging for all employees by providing opportunities to develop, grow, and engage with our global organization all while having fun doing great work. BSI is a community where everyone can thrive.


  • If you require any reasonable accommodations to be made on account of a disability or impairment throughout out our recruiting process, please inform your Talent Acquisition Partner.

title: Staff Software Engineer (Backend)
description:
About Artisan

At Artisan, we’re building real AI employees - not copilots, not assistants, but autonomous teammates.


Our first, Ava, is an AI BDR. She finds and researches leads, writes emails in customers’ tone of voice, runs outbound sequences, self-optimizes, and manages email deliverability infrastructure. She learns, adapts, and improves over time - just like a human would.


Human team members use Artisan as their primary working platform, replacing a sprawling stack of sales tools, and have Artisans working alongside them.


We went through Y Combinator (W24) and have raised $35M+ from top investors. We’re at $7M+ ARR, with hundreds of customers including Remote, Quora, and SumUp. We’re currently working on Ava 2.0, pushing the boundaries of what an AI employee can do. And we're hiring.


Your Mission

You’ll design, build, and scale the backend that powers AI employees while following our principles:

  • Velocity is Everything:  keep the 20/80 rule in mind, delay kills growth
  • Think Like a Founder:  ship with quality, have strong opinions, and speak up if you disagree
  • Operate With Efficiency:  put the customer first, write it down, and use AI wherever possible
  • Communication Rules Everything:  be clear and concise, give candid, unsolicited feedback
  • Meetings, But Make Them Useful:  don’t attend meetings where you don’t add or extract value; Presence ≠ productivity
  • Vibes Matter:  have a positive attitude, make others feel appreciated, we’re here to win


What You Bring

  • 6+ years of backend engineering experience in high-growth environments, preferably early-stage or Series B.
  • Strong experience building scalable, data-intensive services with modern APIs and robust infrastructure.
  • Proficiency with AWS and GitHub Actions.
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems, APIs, reliability, performance, and database systems (SQL + NoSQL).
  • Experience with modern stacks - TypeScript/Node preferred, but equivalent backend stacks are welcome.
  • Demonstrated track record of ownership - leading parts of systems independently and shipping with impact.
  • Excellent communication, clarity in articulating architecture to technical and non-technical stakeholders.


What Makes This Role Stand Out

  • Stay relevant:  At Artisan we are creating AI employees and you'll learn how to not be replaced by one.
  • Ownership and autonomy:  You'll be given trust, and expected excellence.
  • Compensation:  Real equity upside and compensation aligned with high expectations and high impact.
  • Culture:  Have a chat with our teammates, each and everyone has a clear reason about why they love it.

title: Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor Role
description:
Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor


Downstream · Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela


About Downstream


Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision: bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.


We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.


The Role


We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI/UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.


At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to:

  • Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.
  • Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.
  • Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast: prototype, test, iterate, and refine.
  • Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.


Responsibilities

  • Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.
  • Build and maintain UI/UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.
  • Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.
  • Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.
  • Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.


What We’re Looking For

  • Battle-tested designer: You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).
  • AI-forward mindset: You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.
  • Builder’s DNA: Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.
  • Technical & design skills:
  • UI/UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus: Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)
  • Startup mentality: Hands-on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.
  • Industry experience: Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open-source design systems or AI products.


Why Downstream

  • Early-stage, high-growth startup with real traction.
  • Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.
  • Opportunity to shape AI-native product experiences in an industry that hasn’t seen this level of innovation before.
  • Competitive salary + equity

title: UX/UI Designer
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


You’ll be working alongside our Lead Desktop Designer day-to-day, while also collaborating regularly with the larger design team, motion graphics team, and user acquisition team to bring ideas to life from wireframes to polished UIs. While the lead drives the vision, you’ll turn concepts into reality with speed, precision, and polish. You’ll also stay responsive to shifting priorities, adapt to quick turnarounds, and always design with developer feasibility in mind. This is not a research- or strategy-heavy role. We’re looking for someone who’s happy to execute, tweak, and finesse. If you love clean pixels, smooth systems, and being the reliable engine behind great product design this is your role.


Key Responsibilities


  • Translate wireframes and rough concepts into crisp, production-ready designs
  • Build and maintain high-quality UI components for browser extensions and desktop apps
  • Collaborate closely with our lead designer and developers to ensure fast, clean handoff
  • Make smart decisions about when to polish vs. when to ship
  • Adapt to shifting priorities and irregular work cadences without missing a beat
  • Keep designs tight, lean, and respectful of developer constraints
  • Bring taste and craft, even to tight-turnaround projects
  • Contribute to a shared design system and maintain consistency across platforms


Who You Are


  • 3+ years of UI/UX experience with a strong emphasis on desktop design
  • A portfolio that shows clean, dev-friendly UI work—bonus for any
  • browser-related experience or browser extension examples
  • Deep proficiency with Figma and an efficient, systemized approach to
  • design
  • Ability to take direction, iterate fast, and not get precious
  • Strong eye for detail and consistency
  • Comfort working in ambiguity and shifting strategies
  • Respect for dev workloads—your work should make their lives easier, not
  • harder
  • Reliable, communicative, and fun to work with under pressure


Nice to Have


  • Experience designing responsive layouts for desktop applications, with
  • consideration for mobile and adaptive views
  • Light working knowledge of HTML/CSS/JS (enough to understand
  • constraints)
  • Comfort using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Midjourney) for speed and
  • inspiration
  • Familiarity with accessibility and internationalization basics

title: Software Engineer (C#, .NET 8, Azure, GenAI)
description:
Role: Software Engineer – Investments (C#, .NET 8, Azure, GenAI))

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: Long Term

Work Hours: CST

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Location: 100% Remote (Candidates Can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)


About the Role

We’re looking for a talented Software Engineer to join our Investments Technology team , helping design and build secure, scalable healthcare and identity management platforms . You’ll work across the stack using C#, .NET 8+, Azure , and Angular , while leveraging GitHub Copilot and other GenAI tools to accelerate development and innovation.

This is an exciting opportunity to work on cloud-native, event-driven systems that power secure healthcare and financial applications in a collaborative, remote-first environment.


What You’ll Do

  • Design and Build Scalable Solutions: Develop secure, high-performance applications using C#, .NET 8+, Entity Framework , and SQL .
  • Architect Modern Systems: Implement REST APIs, event-driven microservices , and integrations using Azure Service Bus and API Management (APIM) .
  • Leverage Azure Cloud: Deploy and manage applications on Azure App Service , integrate messaging, and expose APIs securely.
  • Implement Secure Authentication: Enhance identity management solutions using OAuth2 and OpenID Connect for secure access control.
  • Develop Front-End Interfaces: Build responsive UIs with Angular, TypeScript, and HTML to deliver excellent user experiences.
  • Optimize Data & APIs: Write efficient SQL queries, design APIs with OpenAPI/Swagger , and use Copilot to automate documentation.
  • Collaborate Across Teams: Partner with Product, DevOps, and QA to deliver seamless, high-quality releases within CI/CD pipelines .
  • Innovate with GenAI: Use GitHub Copilot and prompt engineering to generate code, API specs, and test scripts, boosting productivity and speed.


What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience building production-grade applications with C# and .NET Core/8+ .
  • Strong understanding of REST , event-driven , and microservice architectures.
  • Experience with Azure App Service, Service Bus, and APIM .
  • Proficiency in SQL and Entity Framework for database interactions.
  • Front-end experience with Angular, TypeScript, and HTML .
  • Expertise with OpenAPI/Swagger for API documentation.
  • Hands-on experience with GitHub Copilot or similar GenAI tools.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills in remote, cross-functional teams.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Azure Active Directory (AAD) or other IAM platforms.
  • Familiarity with healthcare compliance (HIPAA) and secure data handling.
  • Exposure to Azure Event Hubs , Kafka , or AutoGen frameworks.

title: Account Manager (Adtech)
description:
Location: Remote

About Us

Orange Storm is a venture-backed AdTech and AI SaaS company with dual headquarters in California, USA and Barcelona, Spain. We provide an integrated ecosystem—including a DSP, SSP, Creative Studio, and AI-driven analytics platform—to help publishers and advertisers drive higher revenue and smarter decisions.

Our global, diverse team is our greatest asset. With a culture rooted in trust, ownership, and continuous learning, we empower talent to grow, experiment, and deliver real-world impact. We are proud of our collaborative spirit, agile execution, and commitment to building scalable, high-performance technologies that adapt to the ever-evolving AdTech landscape.


Role Overview:

We are seeking a high-performing Account Manager to manage and expand relationships with our advertising clients across the APAC region, including direct advertisers and agencies.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage end-to-end client relationships, ensuring successful campaign delivery, optimization, and KPI achievement.
  • Develop and implement advertising strategies to drive client ROI and campaign performance.
  • Collaborate with internal teams (operations, product, tech) to ensure smooth execution and timely issue resolution.
  • Provide clients with regular data analysis, performance reports, and actionable insights.
  • Identify upselling, cross-selling, and expansion opportunities within existing accounts.
  • Stay informed about APAC advertising market trends and competitive landscape.


Requirements:

  • 2+ years of experience in digital advertising, programmatic, or mobile marketing as an Account Manager or Customer Success Manager.
  • Fluent in English; proficiency in Mandarin is a plus.
  • Solid understanding of advertising operations, SDKs, attribution platforms like Appsflyer or Adjust, and fraud prevention.
  • Strong project management, client servicing, and communication skills.
  • Excellent analytical skills with a data-driven approach to optimization.
  • Highly self-motivated, results-oriented, and capable of managing multiple accounts remotely across time zones.


Compensation & Benefits:

  • Attractive and competitive pay and Performance Bonus + Uncapped Revenue Commission!
  • Annual Leave: 20 working days paid leave per year (pro-rated) + local public holidays
  • Remote Work: Fully remote with reasonable overlap hours; occasional travel budget if needed
  • And many more!


Orange Storm is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We value diversity at all levels of the organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to these factors.


We truly appreciate the time and effort every candidate puts into applying to Orange Storm. If your profile aligns with the role and we decide to move forward, a member of our team will reach out to you directly. We thank you in advance for your understanding and for considering a career with us.

title: Bolsista Mestre - Grupo Boticário - Futuro da Beleza - Vaga Afirmativa Para Talentos Diversos  | Talento Inovação -IEL/PR
description:
O Programa Talento Inovação do IEL Paraná tem como foco selecionar, acompanhar e desenvolver bolsistas, além de coordenar ações com organizações parceiras. Ele convida indústrias a proporem projetos de Pesquisa, Desenvolvimento e Inovação (PD&I) nos quais a participação dos bolsistas promova o crescimento profissional em PD&I empresarial e contribua para a inovação da empresa. O programa oferece bolsas para graduandos, graduados, mestres e doutores, permitindo atividades de PD&I nas instalações das empresas pelo território nacional, após aprovação da Comissão Interna do IEL Paraná.


Projeto: Futuro da Beleza - Vaga afirmativa é para talentos diversos — Pessoa com Deficiência, Pessoas Negras (pretas e pardas), Pessoas 45+, Comunidade LGBTQI+ e Mulheres (Cis e Trans)


Sobre a Oportunidade:

No Grupo Boticário, acreditamos que inovar é conectar hoje com o amanhã. O projeto tem como propósito apoiar a equipe de Inovação Estratégica de Produtos na estratégia do projeto Futuro da Beleza, identificando as rotas tecnológicas de produto mais promissoras para os próximos anos. Nosso objetivo é traduzir tendências em oportunidades concretas, transformando ciência e tecnologia em valor para milhões de consumidores.

Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de explorar territórios de inovação já mapeados, caracterizar e quantificar rotas tecnológicas a partir da análise de ICTs, empresas e startups, além de colaborar com áreas estratégicas como marketing, foresight, categoria (embalagem e formulação) e pesquisa.

O resultado esperado é a conexão entre a estratégia de inovação de curto prazo e as de médio e longo prazo, garantindo maior eficiência na identificação de oportunidades tecnológicas em PD&I. Se você tem perfil analítico, curiosidade para explorar novas fronteiras da ciência e vontade de gerar impacto real no futuro da beleza, que desejam cocriar conosco o amanhã da beleza.

Essa vaga afirmativa é para talentos diversos — Pessoa com Deficiência, Pessoas Negras (pretas e pardas), Pessoas 45+, Comunidade LGBTQI+ e Mulheres (Cis e Trans).


Formação Acadêmica: Mestre em Engenharia, Biotecnologia, Química, Farmácia, Analytics, Data Science, Estratégia ou Marketing.

Principais Atividades:

  • Realizar buscas em bases de dados já pré-definidas na metodologia, mapear e consolidar as tecnologias levantadas.
  • Fazer a análise crítica dos dados obtidos e cruzar com estratégia de inovação do Grupo Boticário.
  • Caracterizar as rotas tecnológicas identificadas de acordo com metodologia pré-definida.
  • Calibrar pesquisa com consumidores e realizar consolidação do material e análise crítica dos resultados.
  • Construir a apresentação do relatório final.

Job Description

A Genesis Consulting tem oportunidade para Engenheiros de IA experientes com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e entrega de valor através da tecnologia. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades.

• Pesquisar, desenvolver e implementar metodologias avançadas de Large Language Models (LLMs) para criação de produtos de dados baseados em IA generativa.

• Desenvolver e aprimorar técnicas de Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), combinando embeddings e bancos de vetores para melhorar precisão e relevância das respostas dos modelos.

• Aplicar técnicas de segurança e governança para IA generativa, mitigando alucinações, viés e riscos éticos no uso de LLMs.

• Automatizar e monitorar o desempenho de modelos generativos em produção, utilizando frameworks de MLOps e ferramentas de observabilidade de IA.

• Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com times de engenharia, produto e negócio para transformar desafios empresariais em soluções escaláveis baseadas em IA generativa.

Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

• Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento e aplicação de LLMs e fluxos agênticos.

• Forte domínio de Python, frameworks como LangGraph, PydanticAI, LlamaIndex, e ferramentas de MLOps para produção de modelos generativos.

• Proficiência em Vector Databases (FAISS, ChromaDB, Weaviate, Milvus, Pinecone) e pipelines de dados escaláveis.

• Conhecimento avançado em Machine Learning, Deep Learning e Fine-Tuning de modelos fundacionais.

• Experiência com deploy e monitoramento de modelos em produção, incluindo técnicas de inferência eficiente, caching e otimização.

• Familiaridade com conceitos de governança, segurança e alinhamento de modelos generativos.

  • Ensino superior completo.
  • Inglês Fluente

title: Technical Writer
description:
Overview: Algoseek is seeking a Technical Writer – Financial Documentation to create clear, structured, and comprehensive documentation for our datasets and APIs. This role requires both technical precision and financial knowledge, turning complex data and APIs into content that is accurate, accessible, and client-friendly. You will work closely with developers, data engineers, and product teams to ensure consistency, clarity, and usability across all documentation.


Role Details:

  • Location: 100% Remote (Global Team)
  • Job Type: Full-time
  • Compensation: Competitive, with additional growth opportunities


Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain clear, accurate, and structured documentation for financial APIs, datasets, and schemas.
  • Create detailed descriptions of datasets, fields, parameters, and references with consistent terminology.
  • Explain complex financial concepts (market data, instruments, indicators) in simple, client-friendly language .
  • Provide usage examples (sample queries, API calls, JSON responses) for APIs and datasets.
  • Collaborate with developers, data engineers, and product managers to gather technical details.
  • Define and enforce documentation standards, style guides, and consistency across products.
  • Continuously improve documentation based on feedback from clients and internal teams.


Essential Requirements:

  • Proven experience as a Technical Writer, Data Documentation Specialist, or related role .
  • Strong understanding of APIs, datasets, data models, and JSON structures .
  • Background in finance or trading , with knowledge of instruments, market data, or financial reporting.
  • Excellent written English with the ability to simplify complex technical and financial concepts.
  • Ability to structure and organize large sets of documentation logically and consistently .
  • Skilled at collaborating with cross-functional teams (engineering, product, data, QA).


Desirable Requirements:

  • Experience with API documentation tools (e.g., OpenAPI).
  • Familiarity with data modeling tools and metadata management.
  • Basic knowledge of Python .
  • Understanding of developer experience and user-centered documentation design.
  • Prior work in fintech, data providers, or market intelligence platforms .
  • Ability to create visual aids (ER diagrams, data flow charts, architecture overviews).


Work Hours:

  • Flexible remote setup with required availability for critical U.S. market overlap hours . (fixed EST hours – 9 to 1PM)
  • Occasional late-evening coverage for key delivery periods.


What Success Looks Like

  • Clear, structured documentation that makes complex datasets and APIs accessible .
  • Consistent terminology and standards across all technical content .
  • Documentation that improves client adoption and reduces support overhead.
  • Positive feedback from internal teams and external clients on clarity and usability.


Why Join Algoseek?

  • Work with a leading provider of high-quality market data and trading solutions.
  • Collaborate with world-class engineers, researchers, and financial experts.
  • Drive innovation in automated trading systems and distributed market data solutions.
  • Be part of a remote-first, globally distributed team with a culture of ownership and excellence.


What We Offer:

  • Competitive monthly compensation aligned with experience and responsibilities.
  • A 100% remote work setup with flexibility for work-life balance.
  • An opportunity to contribute to the growth of an innovative, fast-paced market data company.
  • Professional development opportunities to help you grow into higher leadership roles.
  • If you’re a skilled finance professional ready to take the next step in your career, we’d love to hear from you! Please send your resume and a brief overview of your background and availability.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Important Information

The DevOps engineer evaluates emerging technologies, promotes process improvements, and shapes standards and best practices while providing expert guidance to project teams across the organization.   • Experience with IaC tools, ideally Terraform and Helm Charts;

Highly Desirable Skills

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Technical Writer
description:
Overview: Algoseek is seeking a Technical Writer – Financial Documentation to create clear, structured, and comprehensive documentation for our datasets and APIs. This role requires both technical precision and financial knowledge, turning complex data and APIs into content that is accurate, accessible, and client-friendly. You will work closely with developers, data engineers, and product teams to ensure consistency, clarity, and usability across all documentation.


Role Details:

  • Location: 100% Remote (Global Team)
  • Job Type: Full-time
  • Compensation: Competitive, with additional growth opportunities


Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain clear, accurate, and structured documentation for financial APIs, datasets, and schemas.
  • Create detailed descriptions of datasets, fields, parameters, and references with consistent terminology.
  • Explain complex financial concepts (market data, instruments, indicators) in simple, client-friendly language .
  • Provide usage examples (sample queries, API calls, JSON responses) for APIs and datasets.
  • Collaborate with developers, data engineers, and product managers to gather technical details.
  • Define and enforce documentation standards, style guides, and consistency across products.
  • Continuously improve documentation based on feedback from clients and internal teams.


Essential Requirements:

  • Proven experience as a Technical Writer, Data Documentation Specialist, or related role .
  • Strong understanding of APIs, datasets, data models, and JSON structures .
  • Background in finance or trading , with knowledge of instruments, market data, or financial reporting.
  • Excellent written English with the ability to simplify complex technical and financial concepts.
  • Ability to structure and organize large sets of documentation logically and consistently .
  • Skilled at collaborating with cross-functional teams (engineering, product, data, QA).


Desirable Requirements:

  • Experience with API documentation tools (e.g., OpenAPI).
  • Familiarity with data modeling tools and metadata management.
  • Basic knowledge of Python .
  • Understanding of developer experience and user-centered documentation design.
  • Prior work in fintech, data providers, or market intelligence platforms .
  • Ability to create visual aids (ER diagrams, data flow charts, architecture overviews).


Work Hours:

  • Flexible remote setup with required availability for critical U.S. market overlap hours . (fixed EST hours – 9 to 1PM)
  • Occasional late-evening coverage for key delivery periods.


What Success Looks Like

  • Clear, structured documentation that makes complex datasets and APIs accessible .
  • Consistent terminology and standards across all technical content .
  • Documentation that improves client adoption and reduces support overhead.
  • Positive feedback from internal teams and external clients on clarity and usability.


Why Join Algoseek?

  • Work with a leading provider of high-quality market data and trading solutions.
  • Collaborate with world-class engineers, researchers, and financial experts.
  • Drive innovation in automated trading systems and distributed market data solutions.
  • Be part of a remote-first, globally distributed team with a culture of ownership and excellence.


What We Offer:

  • Competitive monthly compensation aligned with experience and responsibilities.
  • A 100% remote work setup with flexibility for work-life balance.
  • An opportunity to contribute to the growth of an innovative, fast-paced market data company.
  • Professional development opportunities to help you grow into higher leadership roles.
  • If you’re a skilled finance professional ready to take the next step in your career, we’d love to hear from you! Please send your resume and a brief overview of your background and availability.

title: ANALISTA PREVENÇÃO RISCOS E FRAUDES PL
description:
Resumo da Vaga:

O Analista de Prevenção a Riscos e Fraudes Pleno será responsável por investigar denúncias e suspeitas de fraudes no Grupo Petrópolis, recebidas pelo Canal de Conduta e outros meios oficiais. O profissional atuará de maneira imparcial, ética e legal, visando identificar e esclarecer fatos, fraudes de colaboradores e terceiros. O foco é fornecer informações cruciais para a tomada de decisões dentro dos parâmetros legais, normas e procedimentos internos, além de apoiar o jurídico nas análises dos casos.



OBJETIVOS:

Avaliação de Denúncias e Demandas:

  • Analisar e avaliar denúncias de fraudes oriundas do Canal de Conduta e outros meios oficiais, identificando os procedimentos a serem adotados e contribuindo com informações para decisões internas.

Investigações Sistêmicas:

  • Realizar investigações utilizando sistemas internos, envolvendo públicos internos e externos, para detectar violações legais, políticas e procedimentos. Identificar oportunidades de ações corretivas nos processos da empresa contribuindo para melhoria contínua.

Investigações em Campo:

  • Conduzir investigações, com diligências e contato com testemunhas e envolvidos, coletando evidências (vídeos, fotos, depoimentos, relatórios) para subsidiar a investigação.

Elaboração de Relatórios:

  • Preparar relatórios detalhados com os resultados das investigações, identificando falhas ou não conformidades e informando as áreas pertinentes, como o departamento jurídico.
  • Atualização Constante:

Manter-se atualizado quanto às normas e procedimentos internos relativos às investigações e prevenção a fraudes.

  • Apoio à Gestão:

Auxiliar na criação de materiais e apresentações para reporte à gestão, além de apoiar na elaboração e revisão de diretrizes e procedimentos do departamento.



DIFERENCIAIS:

  • Experiência em Segurança Pública: Profissionais com histórico em segurança pública, como policiais, bombeiros ou agentes de segurança;
  • Cursos relacionados a investigação e prevenção de fraudes, técnicas de entrevista, conhecimento em Compliance e Canal de conduta;
  • Experiência nas Forças Armadas: Profissionais com experiência militar, incluindo ex-militares e reservistas.



REQUISITOS:

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Administração de Empresas, Gestão em Segurança Empresarial, Investigações de fraudes, Compliance e áreas correlacionadas;
  • Conhecimentos básicos das atividades de Compliance;
  • Gestão de Riscos e Investigações;
  • Análise de Dados;
  • Conhecimento no sistema SAP;
  • Excel Intermediário/ Avançado e BI;
  • Experiência na área de prevenção à fraude;
  • Conhecimento de coleta de dados e informações de fontes públicas (OSINT);
  • Habilitação categoria B ativa;

description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Somos a área responsável pela coleta, tratamento, organização e disponibilização dos dados nas soluções e API da Neoway, bem como manter a sustentação desses dados. Nossos times estão organizados de acordo com o contexto de negócio de cada pacote de dados que sustentamos. Estes times são compostos por uma coordenação técnica, responsável por fazer a ponte entre os times de dados e o time de negócio, e pessoas Engenheiras de Dados, responsáveis pelo desenvolvimento e configuração de todas as etapas do fluxo da operação e produção de dados.

Dentre as principais funções do papel estão:

  • Desenvolvimento de web crawling para coleta de dados;
  • Monitoramento dos serviços de produção;
  • Evolução e manutenção de serviços de coleta, tratamento e agregação;


#Requisitos e qualificações:

Para desenvolver tudo isso contamos que você possua/ou esteja a fim de aprender os conhecimentos abaixo:

  • Desenvolvimento web crawling;
  • Linguagem de programação Python;
  • MongoDB, Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQL;
  • Parser de HTML, JSON, PDF, entre outros;


Seguimos práticas básicas de desenvolvimento:

  • Testes unitários, integração, e em alguns casos, sistema.
  • Projeto de infraestrutura como código.
  • Usamos CI do gitlab, para automatizar a maior parte de rotinas (testes, release).
  • Nos preocupamos com um código limpo e bem estruturado.
  • Fazemos Code Review. Nenhuma mudança vai para a operação sem o time aprovar. Seja via thumbs up do Gitlab ou durante uma discussão da daily.
  • Todo desenvolvimento de uma nova fonte é baseado em especificações que são escritas pela nossa pessoa Data Owner. Nela temos as definições de inputs e outputs, regras de negócio e resultados esperados. A especificação técnica fica sob responsabilidade do desenvolvedor que tem total abertura para decidir a melhor forma de desenvolvimento em conjunto com os demais colegas de time.

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei profissional da área de desenvovlimento venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um(a/e) #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


- Experiência mínima de 2 anos em desenvolvimento frontend, com foco em React Native para aplicativos mobile.

* Forte conhecimento em TypeScript e JavaScript.

* Experiência prática com bibliotecas de gerenciamento de estado em apps móveis, especialmente Redux.

* Conhecimento em Firebase (Analytics, Crashlytics, Remote Config).

* Vivência com CI/CD para distribuição e deploy de aplicativos móveis.

* Domínio em controle de versão utilizando Git e aplicação de boas práticas em versionamento.

* Experiência em testes automatizados com Jest.


Desejável: * Familiaridade com ferramentas de documentação de API, como Swagger.

* Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e boas práticas de gestão de projetos. Tecnologias e Ferramentas que você irá utilizar:

* Backend: NestJS e Node.js

* Frontend Mobile: React Native

* Cloud: AWS (SQS, S3)

* Firebase (Analytics, Crashlytics, Remote Config)

* Linguagens: TypeScript e JavaScript

* Versionamento: Git


- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Backend Software Engineer
description:
Sobre a Vaga

Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Backend experiente e motivado(a), com 3 a 5 anos de experiência na criação de sistemas backend escaláveis utilizando Java e Spring Boot. Neste cargo, você irá projetar e implementar APIs e microsserviços que sustentam aplicações críticas de POS para o varejo. Trabalhará em colaboração com equipes multifuncionais e com tecnologias modernas de nuvem, incluindo Amazon Aurora e DynamoDB. Experiência com desenvolvimento nativo Android, nativo Windows e full stack será um diferencial importante.


Responsabilidades Principais

• Projetar, desenvolver e manter serviços backend e APIs RESTful usando Java e Spring Boot

• Criar microsserviços escaláveis e nativos em nuvem seguindo boas práticas de engenharia de software

• Trabalhar com Amazon Aurora e DynamoDB para modelagem de dados, armazenamento e otimização de performance

• Colaborar com gerentes de produto, desenvolvedores frontend e QA para entregar funcionalidades de alta qualidade

• Construir e manter integrações com sistemas internos e externos

• Participar de code reviews, planejamento de sprints, deploys e resposta a incidentes

• Garantir desempenho, segurança e confiabilidade dos serviços backend em produção


Qualificações Obrigatórias

• 3–5 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento backend com Java (8 ou superior) e Spring Boot

• Experiência prática com desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful e arquitetura de microsserviços

• Proficiência em bancos SQL e NoSQL

• Experiência sólida com Amazon Aurora (PostgreSQL)

• Familiaridade com Amazon DynamoDB e modelagem eficiente para NoSQL

• Forte entendimento de multithreading, concorrência e tuning de performance

• Familiaridade com Git, pipelines CI/CD e ferramentas de build (Maven/Gradle)

• Experiência em deploy e monitoramento de serviços em ambientes cloud (preferencialmente AWS)

• Fortes habilidades analíticas e de troubleshooting


Qualificações Desejáveis

• Experiência com serviços AWS, como Lambda, S3, API Gateway, ECS ou EKS

• Familiaridade com arquitetura orientada a eventos e ferramentas como Kafka ou SQS

• Experiência com Docker e orquestração via Kubernetes

• Conhecimento de práticas de codificação segura, segurança de APIs e OAuth2

• Experiência com testes unitários e de integração usando JUnit, Mockito ou frameworks similares

• Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e logging como CloudWatch, ELK stack ou Datadog

description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.

Quem somos:

Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!

Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.

  • Inovar . Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.

  • Atuar em toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (criação de infraestruturas e plataformas, coleta de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, criações de APIs REST, de front-ends, de testes, implementações contínuas).
  • Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados.

  • Ter cursado graduação em ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.
  • Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes. Você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor, que pode ser front-end, back-end, infraestrutura de big data, modelo de ML...

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:

  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de traduzir decisões técnicas em linguagem de negócio ;

  • Autonomia e proatividade na resolução de problemas;
  • Curiosidade e aprendizado contínuo , buscando sempre novas abordagens e soluções.


Por que fazer parte da TIVIT

Na TIVIT, você fará parte de uma equipe que acredita na inovação como motor de transformação , com liberdade para propor, testar e construir soluções que impactam grandes negócios . Aqui, valorizamos profissionais que unem visão estratégica, capacidade técnica e atitude protagonista .

title: Creative Strategist
description:
WHO ARE WE?


We’re a fast-growing consumer brand group selling across e-commerce, TikTok Shop, and Amazon. We prioritize direct-response strategy, product quality, and measurable efficacy. The team moves fast and operates with a high bar.


WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?


We’re hiring a Creative Strategist with heavy direct response experience.


You’ll own both strategy and ops: building and briefing angles, scripting iterations, managing sprints, reviewing edits, and ensuring we ship 100–200 ads per week.


You must have lived and breathed direct response advertising and VSL-style creative—knowing the beats, pacing, proof, and psychology that drive conversions. This is a hands-on IC role with pod-level ownership (no formal people management).


Focus split:

● ~60% Strategy/Briefing

● ~40% Creative Ops/QA/Delivery


HOW TO APPLY: If you believe we're the right fit, please fill in this form:


WHAT WILL YOU DO?


Direct Response Strategy / Briefing / Analysis

● Develop a creative strategy by offer, funnel, and awareness stage; publish weekly test plans.

● Generate net-new DR angles from learnings, competitor swipes, and cultural trends.

● Outline 2–3 minute VSL-style ads (problem, agitation, solution, proof, CTA) and collaborate with copy on scripting.

● Write iteration briefs (hook swaps, lead/body edits, CTA tests, packaging, captions) with clear hypotheses.

● Brief content creators with DR talking tracks, shot lists, compliance guardrails, and demo guidelines.

● Lead reviews to ensure DR structure, pacing, and storytelling are dialed in.

● Translate performance data (Hook, Hold, CTR, CPC, CPA, ROAS) into new test briefs within 1–3 days.


Creative Ops & Delivery

● Own weekly sprints: intake → brief → production → QA → launch → iteration.

● Plan and ship 100–200 ads weekly (mix of new and iterations).

● Traffic assets correctly: naming, specs (9:16 / 4:5 / 1:1), captions, UTMs.

● QA assets for typos, compliance, pacing, audio, and render quality.

● Review editor work with time-stamped, DR-specific notes (cut logic, proof beats, motion/graphics, sound).

● Maintain a clean, searchable DAM with version control.

● Coordinate with Media/Growth to ensure launches hit deadlines.

● Use light automation/AI for cut-downs, resizing, and captions.

● Track throughput and ensure weekly volume targets are met without errors.

● Manage creator usage rights and content expirations.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE (FIRST 90 DAYS)

● 100–200 DR ads shipped weekly , >98% QA pass rate .

● Iterations launched within 24–48 hours of insights , increasing win rate.

● Faster time-to-first-winner and more winners per 50 launches.

● A standardized system for DR briefs (VSL, creator, iteration) used by the team.

● Clean DAM and clear creative pipeline visible to Growth/Media .


MUST-HAVES

● 3+ years in direct response creative strategy, ideally in high-spend environments ($1MM+/mo).

● Deep experience with VSL-style ads : structure, beats, proof, pacing, CTA flow.

● Proven ability to ship 100–200 ads weekly across VSLs, short-form, and UGC.

● Strong post-production literacy (Premiere/Final Cut/AE basics) for precise DR feedback.

● Track record of writing/briefing iterations and content creators for DR assets .

● Data-driven mindset; you live in Hook/Hold/CTR/CPC/CPA/ROAS.

● Detail-oriented; errors don’t slip past you.

● Clear communicator who pushes creative toward DR performance.


NICE-TO-HAVES

● Health, beauty, or OTC-adjacent experience.

● Amazon and TikTok Shop creative systems.

● Familiarity with tools: ClickUp/Asana, Frame.io, Motion/Varos, Google Workspace, CapCut/Descript, Runway/Topaz/ElevenLabs

title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
For Brazil Only, PJ contract, Fluent English


Position: Senior Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Work Hours: Must have overlap with U.S. Central Time

Start Date: Immediate

Contract Type: PJ (Pessoa Jurídica)

Duration: 3-4 months

Language Requirement: Fluent English required ( U.S.-based company)


Summary

We’re looking for an experienced QA Engineer who ramps up quickly on complex business domains and turns that understanding into clear, risk-based test strategies. You’ll combine strong manual testing skills with proven test case design and automation in .NET (C#) to raise the bar on quality across web, API, and data flows. You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, and DevOps to deliver reliable, testable, and observable software continuously.


What You’ll Do

  • Translate business processes into tests: Rapidly learn product/domain concepts and map endtoend workflows into highvalue test scenarios and acceptance criteria.
  • Design and execute test suites: Build and maintain comprehensive manual and automated tests (UI, API, integration, regression, smoke, and exploratory).
  • Build .NET automation: Develop and maintain C# test automation frameworks (e.g., Playwright , Selenium WebDriver , SpecFlow BDD , NUnit/xUnit/MSTest ) aligned to SOLID and POM principles.
  • Enable CI/CD quality gates: Integrate automated tests into pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps , GitHub Actions ) with parallel runs, test reporting, and flaky-test management.
  • Collaborate across disciplines: Work with Product Owners to refine acceptance criteria, with Developers to shift-left quality, and with business users to validate in staging/preproduction environments and in production once deployed.
  • Own defect lifecycle: Identify, document, prioritize, and drive resolution of defects with clear reproduction steps, logs, screenshots, and impact.
  • Data & API validation: Test APIs, validate payloads and contracts (e.g., via Swagger/OpenAPI ), and verify database outcomes (SQL Server ).
  • Non-functional checks: Contribute to performance baselines (e.g., k6 , JMeter ), and security test coordination.
  • Test strategy & traceability: Maintain risk-based test plans, coverage maps, and traceability to requirements/ACs.
  • Mentor & improve: Share best practices, pair on tests, and improve standards for reliability, maintainability, and observability of tests.


Must Have Qualifications

  • Software quality assurance experience, including extensive manual testing and test case design.
  • Proficiency in building and maintaining automated tests in .NET (C#) for UI and/or API layers.
  • Strong understanding of .NET/.NET Core , ASP.NET (MVC/Web API) fundamentals, HTTP, and JSON.
  • Hands-on with Selenium and/or Playwright , plus NUnit/xUnit/MSTest ; experience.
  • Comfortable reading application code, using Visual Studio /Visual Studio Code , debugging tests, and collaborating on testability.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps or GitHub for source control, boards/issues, and CI/CD pipelines.

title: Engenheiro de dados GCP
description:
Estamos em busca de um Engenheiro de Dados com sólida experiência na construção e otimização de pipelines de dados. Este profissional terá papel fundamental no desenho, desenvolvimento e manutenção de soluções de integração de dados confiáveis, escaláveis e seguras. O candidato ideal deve ter forte conhecimento em plataformas de nuvem, práticas modernas de engenharia de dados e perfil analítico para garantir o fluxo eficiente de dados na organização.

Responsabilidades Principais

Projetar, desenvolver e manter pipelines ETL/ELT para ingestão, transformação e entrega de dados estruturados e não estruturados.

Implementar frameworks de ingestão de dados a partir de múltiplas fontes (bancos de dados, APIs, arquivos, streaming etc.).

Garantir qualidade, consistência e confiabilidade dos dados por meio de validação, monitoramento e testes automatizados.

Otimizar fluxos de processamento de dados visando custo e performance.

Colaborar com Cientistas de Dados, Analistas e áreas de negócio para fornecer datasets limpos, confiáveis e bem documentados.

Trabalhar com serviços nativos de nuvem (ex.: BigQuery, Dataproc, Dataflow, Databricks, Snowflake) para implementar arquiteturas escaláveis.

Aplicar boas práticas de CI/CD, versionamento e Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) em pipelines de dados.

Assegurar conformidade com normas de segurança, governança e privacidade (ex.: PII, GDPR, LGPD).

Qualificações Necessárias

Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência comprovada em engenharia de dados, com foco em construção de pipelines.

Domínio em SQL, Python e Spark.

Experiência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (Google Cloud Platform, AWS ou Azure).

Sólidos conhecimentos em modelagem de dados, data warehouse e arquiteturas lake/lakehouse.

Vivência com ferramentas de orquestração (Airflow, Cloud Composer, Prefect, Dagster).

Familiaridade com práticas de DevOps (Git, pipelines CI/CD, Terraform ou similares).

Diferenciais Desejáveis

Experiência com streaming em tempo real (Kafka, Pub/Sub, Kinesis).

Conhecimentos em containerização (Docker, Kubernetes).

Vivência com pipelines de machine learning e MLOps.

Experiência com catálogos de dados, metadata management e ferramentas de governança.

Competências Comportamentais

Perfil analítico e orientado à resolução de problemas.

Capacidade de comunicar conceitos técnicos complexos de forma clara a públicos não técnicos.

Trabalho em equipe, postura proativa e colaborativa.

Inglês fluente (escrito e falado);

espanhol será considerado um diferencial.

title: Senior Backend Engineering Analyst
description:
Sinch is a global customer engagement platform that provides communication services for businesses across messaging, voice, and email. Sinch's services are used by more than 150,000 businesses, including many of the world's largest tech companies.

Join our development team as a Senior Backend Engineering Analyst ! You will be a key player in developing modern web applications and creating surprising new products for our clients. Our team focuses on building global-scale products and managing numerous direct integrations, including Meta (Facebook) for messaging. We also integrate with various platforms using APIs, queuing, and streaming technologies.


Activities

While responsibilities vary, in a general context, here's what we expect from you daily:

  • Deliver technology projects/products aligned with the company's strategic objectives (OKRs) , collaborating with the product team to suggest and develop new functionalities.
  • Architect and develop APIs for incredible conversational experiences and integrations using modern development technologies.
  • Develop and maintain scalable backend systems for a robust, global messaging platform (e.g., WhatsApp and SMS channels).
  • Collaboratively develop and enhance distributed backend services that meet our customers' needs.
  • Actively participate in discussions about product features and technical solutions to solve customer problems and scale our solution.
  • Master integrations and communications using REST APIs .
  • Practice code versioning (Git) , with experience in Pull Requests and Code Review.
  • Work effectively in a team environment-we don't build software alone!


Requirements

  • Solid experience in a functional language like Elixir, Erlang, Go, Rust, or Clojure .
  • Experience developing RESTful and gRPC APIs .
  • Strong knowledge of distributed system architecture, data structures, algorithms, and software design patterns .
  • Practical knowledge of Agile development methodologies .
  • Solid understanding of relational databases .
  • Experience with Unit Testing and Integration Testing .

We are looking for people who:

title: Staff ML Engineer
description:
About the Product

Niche is the leader in school search. Our mission is to make researching and enrolling in schools easy, transparent, and free. With in-depth profiles on every school and college in America, 140 million reviews and ratings, and powerful search tools, we help millions of people find the right school for them. We also help thousands of schools recruit more best-fit students, by highlighting what makes them great and making it easier to visit and apply.

Niche is all about finding where you belong, and that mission inspires how we operate every day. We want Niche to be a place where people truly enjoy working and can thrive professionally.


About the Role

We are looking for our first Staff Machine Learning Engineer to establish and lead our machine learning initiatives. This is a critical, foundational role where you will have the unique opportunity to shape the future of data science and ML at Niche. You will be responsible for identifying high-impact opportunities, designing, building, and deploying machine learning models that directly drive business growth and enhance user experience across our platform.

We are looking for a highly skilled, hands-on practitioner who is passionate about translating business challenges into data-driven solutions. You build, you code, you ship, you measure. You have a proven history of deploying ML models into production environments that have delivered tangible results. You possess the experience and desire to mentor future ML hires and establish best practices as our capabilities grow.


What You Will Do

  • Identify & Prioritize: Collaborate closely with product, engineering, data analytics, and business stakeholders to identify and prioritize the most impactful ML opportunities that align with Niche’s strategic goals. Our first area of focus is our Recommendations, which includes matching students with the right schools
  • Design & Build: Lead the end-to-end development of machine learning models – from data collection and feature engineering to algorithm selection, training, tuning, and validation. This is a hands-on coding role
  • Deploy & Integrate: Develop production-grade code and systems to deploy, serve, and monitor ML models at scale, ensuring reliability and performance. Integrate models effectively into Niche’s products and internal systems
  • Measure & Iterate: Define key performance metrics, establish robust monitoring frameworks, analyze model performance in production, and drive continuous improvement through iteration and experimentation
  • Champion & Evangelize: Clearly communicate complex ML concepts, model behaviors, and results to both technical and non-technical audiences. Champion the use of machine learning & data science across the organization
  • Lead & Mentor: Establish ML development best practices, coding standards, and documentation. As the function grows you will guide and mentor other ML engineers
  • Innovate: Stay abreast of the latest advancements in machine learning, data science, and MLOps, evaluating and potentially adopting new technologies and techniques relevant to Niche


First Year Plan

During the 1st Month:

  • Learn about Niche by meeting with various team members to learn more about our company through our Onboarding meetings
  • Deep-dive into Niche’s platform, data architecture, and recommendation systems
  • Align with product and engineering teams on business goals and ML impact areas
  • Begin shaping a roadmap for high-impact ML opportunities

Within 3 Months:

  • Deploy your first machine learning model into production with robustmonitoring and
  • feedback loops
  • Collaborate with product and engineering to define success metrics andintegration
  • strategies
  • Establish early ML development workflows, documentation, andperformance monitoring
  • Contribute production-ready code for feature engineering and modelexperimentation

Within 6 Months:

  • Drive measurable improvements through experimentation and model iteration
  • Introduce scalable MLOps practices to support deployment, retraining, and governance
  • Serve as a mentor and set engineering best practices for a growing ML function

Within 12 Months:

  • Lead ML efforts across multiple product areas, driving business impact at scale
  • Influence company-wide strategy through technical leadership and ML evangelism
  • Develop internal tooling, reusable frameworks, and scalable ML systems
  • Help grow the team through hiring, mentorship, and a culture of innovation


What We Are Looking For

  • Experience: 8+ years of professional experience in software development or data science, with at least 5+ years specifically focused on building and deploying machine learning models in a production environment
  • Proven Impact: Demonstrable track record of successfully shipping multiple machine learning models that resulted in measurable business growth (e.g., increased user engagement, conversion rates, operational efficiency, revenue). You can clearly articulate the business problem, the ML solution, and the quantitative impact achieved
  • Technical Depth (Hands-On):
  • Expertise in Python and common ML libraries/frameworks (e.g., scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, XGBoost)
  • Deep understanding of core ML concepts (e.g., classification, regression, clustering, recommendation systems, NLP, time series analysis, experimentation, model evaluation)
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets and data processing tools (e.g., Pandas, Spark)
  • Experience with ML deployment patterns and MLOps principles (e.g., model serving, monitoring, CI/CD for ML, feature stores)
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) is essential
  • Business Acumen: Strong ability to understand business needs, translate them into well-defined ML problems, and connect technical work back to strategic objectives. You prioritize work based on potential business impact
  • Leadership Experience: Experience or a strong aptitude for leading technical projects, defining technical direction, and mentoring others. Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Education: MS or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field, OR equivalent practical experience demonstrating deep expertise in machine learning


Bonus Points

  • Experience building ML capabilities from the ground up
  • Experience with recommendation systems, search ranking algorithms, or NLP applied to user-generated content
  • Experience in the EdTech or consumer-facing platform space
  • Familiarity with golang, express, Postgres, Snowflake, DBT, and Tableau
  • Contributions to open-source ML projects or publications in relevant conferences/journals


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

title: Business Development Manager Sustainability
description:
Job Title: Business Development Manager – Sustainability

Location: Brazil- Remote

Employment Type: Full-time


About the Role

BSI is seeking an experienced and strategic Business Development Manager (BDM), Sustainability to maintain and grow relationships with large, strategically important clients. You will coordinate BSI’s global efforts to deliver assurance solutions focused on sustainability, greenhouse gas (GHG) verification, reduction, and neutrality.

In this role, you will lead account planning, achieve sales targets by expanding existing accounts and securing new business, and provide thought leadership within the sustainability space. You will also support sales initiatives across the Americas and actively engage in industry events.


In your day to day, you will be responsible for:

  • Achieve assigned sales targets and drive profitable revenue growth.
  • Develop and manage relationships with strategic accounts and senior business leaders.
  • Retain existing accounts through ongoing engagement and partnership with operational teams.
  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities to expand BSI’s sustainability client base.
  • Negotiate contracts and close deals, integrating requirements into operational delivery.
  • Support other sales professionals in selling sustainability and GHG audit services.
  • Collaborate with global marketing, product development, and sales teams on priorities and initiatives.
  • Participate in industry associations, conferences, and events to provide thought leadership.
  • Conduct account health checks, review pricing annually, and facilitate issue resolution.
  • Maintain accurate forecasting and CRM data to support business planning and customer service.
  • Analyze market conditions, competitors, and customer insights to enhance sales performance.


To be successful in the role, you will have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, quimical engineer or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • At least 5 years of experience in solutions sales and business development.
  • Experience selling assessment or audit solutions within professional services.
  • Proven ability to engage senior-level management and manage multinational client relationships.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Salesforce (preferred).
  • Strong skills in communication, persuasion, relationship-building, and performance monitoring.


Career opportunities are vast with around 5,000 employees working with over 82,000 clients in 182 countries. BSI challenges mediocrity and complacency to help embed excellence into the way people and products work. That means showing businesses how to improve performance, reduce risk, and achieve sustainable growth.


What we offer:

BSI offers a competitive total reward package, an independent and varied job in an international environment, flexible working hours, ongoing training and development with the inclusion of 20-days annual leave, bank holidays, medical, dental, vision, and life insurance, short-term and long-term disability, maternal leave, paid parental leave, paid bereavement leave, learning and development opportunities, and a wide range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your lifestyle.


Do you believe the world deserves excellence?

We are proud to be the business improvement company for other organisations to become more sustainable and resilient and finally to inspire trust in their products, systems, services, and the world we live in.


Headquartered in London, BSI is the world's first national standards organization with more than 100 years of experience. We are a global partner for 86,000 companies and organizations in over 193 countries, offering development, auditing, certification, and training services, including innovative software solutions and cyber security expertise for all industries: from aerospace and automotive to food, construction, energy, healthcare, IT and trade sectors. Incorporated by Royal Charter, we’re truly impartial and home to the ultimate mark of trust, the Kitemark.

Through our unique combination of consulting, training, assurance, and regulatory services, we bring solid and broad knowledge to every company.


D&I Policy

BSI is committed to ensuring the diversity of our workforce reflects that of our clients and the communities in which we operate. Our goal is to create a sense of belonging for all employees by providing opportunities to develop, grow, and engage with our global organization, all while having fun doing great work. BSI is a community where everyone can thrive.

If you require any reasonable accommodations to be made on account of a disability or impairment throughout our recruiting process, please inform your Talent Acquisition Partner.
