title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Qualidade
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.



Responsabilidades e atribuições:


  • Coordenar a equipe de SAC, recepção e Ambiência, visando a melhor experiência do cliente e a excelência em atendimento, tratando diretamente situações críticas de atendimento ao cliente e que necessitem de intervenção;
  • Coordenar a equipe do fraldário, proporcionando atendimento e ambientes agradáveis com excelência para aos clientes.
  • Acompanhar e analisar indicadores, bem como as pesquisas de NPS

Career opportunities are vast with around 5,000 employees working with over 82,000 clients in 182 countries. BSI challenges mediocrity and complacency to help embed excellence into the way people and products work. That means showing businesses how to improve performance, reduce risk, and achieve sustainable growth.


What we offer:

BSI offers a competitive total reward package, an independent and varied job in an international environment, flexible working hours, ongoing training and development with the inclusion of 20-days annual leave, bank holidays, medical, dental, vision, and life insurance, short-term and long-term disability, maternal leave, paid parental leave, paid bereavement leave, learning and development opportunities, and a wide range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your lifestyle.


Do you believe the world deserves excellence?

We are proud to be the business improvement company for other organisations to become more sustainable and resilient and finally to inspire trust in their products, systems, services, and the world we live in.

We are a global partner for 86,000 companies and organizations in over 193 countries, offering development, auditing, certification, and training services, including innovative software solutions and cyber security expertise for all industries: from aerospace and automotive to food, construction, energy, healthcare, IT and trade sectors. Incorporated by Royal Charter, we’re truly impartial and home to the ultimate mark of trust, the Kitemark.

Through our unique combination of consulting, training, assurance, and regulatory services, we bring solid and broad knowledge to every company.

BSI is committed to ensuring the diversity of our workforce reflects that of our clients and the communities in which we operate. title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


We are seeking a Full-Stack Data Engineer to join our Mobile Applications department. This is a hybrid role that combines data engineering with data science overlap, giving you full ownership of the data lifecycle — from ingestion to transformation, analysis, and storytelling.

You will build and optimize scalable pipelines, ingest mobile app data from diverse sources, ensure infrastructure reliability, and deliver insights that directly influence how our apps grow. The ideal candidate thrives at the intersection of engineering and analytics, equally capable of writing production-grade pipelines and uncovering meaningful trends in user behavior.


Key Responsibilities


Data Infrastructure & Pipelines

  • Build and maintain scalable, end-to-end pipelines across cloud environments. Ingest and transform data from files, APIs, mobile telemetry (Firebase, Amplitude, Google Analytics), and external databases into centralized stores.
  • Continuously monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize infrastructure for performance, scalability, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Implement data quality monitoring, governance policies, and best practices for privacy, security, and compliance.
  • Participate in technical architecture discussions, contributing expertise on scalable, efficient data systems.


Analytics & Insights

  • Conduct exploratory and advanced analysis using SQL, Python, and statistical methods.
  • Collaborate with Analysts, Data Scientists, and Product Managers to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Support experimentation and A/B testing by ensuring clean, reliable datasets and analyzing results.
  • Deliver actionable recommendations that influence mobile product strategy, user acquisition, and retention.


Collaboration & Best Practices

  • Engage in peer code reviews to uphold high standards of quality and maintainability.
  • Work cross-functionally with software engineering and business teams to ensure data solutions align with company priorities.
  • Document pipelines, workflows, and methodologies to foster reusability and knowledge sharing.


Who You Are


  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 3+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar technical role focused on data infrastructure and pipelines.
  • Strong expertise in SQL and proficiency in Python (or a similar programming language such as Java or C#).
  • Experience with AWS (Redshift, RDS, S3) and Google Cloud (BigQuery, Firebase) for managing cloud-based databases and analytics tools.
  • Familiarity with data pipeline orchestration tools (dbt, Airflow, or similar).
  • Strong knowledge of data warehousing concepts, ELT/ETL best practices, and dimensional modeling. Experience with version control systems (e.g., GitHub).
  • Excellent communicator who can bridge technical depth with clear storytelling for non-technical stakeholders.

title: CRM Engineer – Integration & Automation
description:
CRM Engineer – Integration & Automation (Contractor)

Schedule: 40 hours per week – Remote


About the Role

Our cliente is looking for a CRM Engineer to join our Integration & Automation team , responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable integrations and automation solutions across business systems.

This role requires a professional with solid hands-on engineering experience — someone who can go beyond configuration and actively build, integrate, and optimize workflows across multiple platforms.



Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain integrations between Salesforce and other enterprise systems (including NetSuite and marketing automation platforms).
  • Build automation solutions leveraging Workato , MuleSoft , and custom code (Node.js, JavaScript).
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders (Sales, Marketing, Support, Finance) to understand business processes and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Develop APIs and workflows that enhance data flow and system interoperability.
  • Troubleshoot integration issues and ensure consistent system performance and scalability.
  • Follow best practices in source control, deployment, and DevOps methodologies for CRM and automation systems.


Required Technical Skills

  • Salesforce (Sales, Service, or CPQ modules) – CPQ experience preferred but not mandatory.
  • Workato (highly preferred) or MuleSoft for system integration and automation.
  • Node.js and JavaScript – strong hands-on experience required.
  • NetSuite (from an integration perspective).
  • Familiarity with REST APIs , OAuth , and SSO .
  • Experience with “drag-and-drop” style integration builders.



Preferred Experience

  • Experience developing or supporting Salesforce automation (Apex, Triggers, LWC).
  • Familiarity with Heroku , Python , or microservice architectures .
  • Exposure to DevOps , Git branching , and Agile methodologies .
  • Experience with Salesforce frameworks like CPQ, Experience Cloud, or Einstein.
  • Solid understanding of data flows, declarative automation vs. custom development, and integration best practices.


Ideal Profile

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with attention to detail.
  • Proactive communicator who collaborates effectively across teams.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities.
  • Focused on delivering scalable, reliable, and maintainable integration solutions.

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes.   • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :  transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.      
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.  
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.  
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;       

  • VR/VT       
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)       
  • Gympass       
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico       
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)       
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados

description:
Job Description:

We are seeking a skilled and experienced Salesforce Lead to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will lead and own the full software development life cycle (SDLC) of Salesforce projects, providing technical leadership and ensuring successful delivery of high-quality solutions. This role requires collaboration with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to gather requirements and translate them into technical specifications.


Responsibilities:

Lead and own the full software development life cycle (SDLC) of Salesforce projects, including requirement analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, and support.

Collaborate with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to gather requirements and translate them into technical specifications.

Design and implement customized solutions on the Salesforce platform using Apex, Lightning Components (Aura/LWC), Visualforce, SOAP/Rest APIs, and declarative tools.

Focus on Salesforce Vlocity development with an emphasis on Enterprise Product Catalog (EPC)/CPQ, Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM), OmniScripts, DataRaptors, and Integration Procedures (IPs).

Plan and create sprints, ensuring a balanced workload and alignment with project timelines and objectives.

Assign tasks to team members based on skillsets, availability, and delivery priorities.

Conduct daily stand-up meetings to track progress, gather updates, and identify and resolve blockers.

Coordinate cross-functionally to ensure timely resolution of dependencies and issues impacting delivery.

Liaise with the testing team to review test scenarios and support test planning activities.

Coordinate with business users for UAT (User Acceptance Testing), ensuring validation of functionality and obtaining final sign-off.

Conduct detailed code reviews and handle deployments using GitHub and Jenkins.

Hold accountability for the successful delivery of assigned Salesforce solutions, meeting both technical and business expectations.

Stay updated with Salesforce platform enhancements and proactively manage critical release updates.


Qualifications:

Proven experience leading Salesforce projects through the full SDLC.

Expertise in Apex, Lightning Components (Aura/LWC), Visualforce, SOAP/REST APIs, and Salesforce declarative tools.

Strong background in Salesforce Vlocity development, particularly with EPC/CPQ, CLM, OmniScripts, DataRaptors, and IPs.

Experience managing offshore teams and supporting existing Salesforce applications.

Ability to provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior developers.

Proficient in performing code reviews and handling deployments using GitHub and Jenkins.

Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Proactive approach to stay informed about platform enhancements and release updates.

Experience in coordinating with business stakeholders to prioritize work, plan sprints, and ensure smooth project delivery.

The professional will proactively identify and mitigate risks, ensuring a smooth and successful transition with minimal disruption to business operations.

  • Experience with database management systems (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle ) to manage and migrate data.
  • Proven knowledge and experience in the design and implementation of ETL processes.
  • Advanced English and/or French.

Soft Skills:

  • Problem Solving: Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Communication: Effective communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Attention to Detail: Strong attention to detail.
  • Adaptability: Ability to work independently and in a team.

Differentials (Nice to Have):

  • Education: Master's degree in a related field.
  • Certifications: Certification in data management (e.g., CDMP) or advanced certifications in data migration tools (e.g., Talend, Informatica ).
  • Knowledge: Experience with data migration to the cloud (AWS, Azure ). Familiarity with agile project management methodologies. Knowledge of data security and privacy regulations.

Nessa posição você irá:

O(A) Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior é responsável por desenhar, construir e otimizar os pipelines de dados que servem como base para as iniciativas de Business Intelligence e Ciência de Dados da empresa. Este profissional atuará como uma referência técnica, garantindo que as soluções de dados sejam escaláveis, seguras e alinhadas às necessidades de negócio. Sua missão é transformar dados brutos em insights acionáveis, trabalhando em ambientes de alto volume e criticidade para suportar decisões estratégicas em públicos heterogêneos.


Principais Responsabilidades

● Desenvolver e manter pipelines de ETL/ELT robustos, utilizando ferramentas como Azure Data Factory, Synapse Pipelines e SSIS.

● Modelar dados em formatos relacionais e multidimensionais (Star Schema) para otimizar consultas e análises.

● Atuar como referência técnica para equipes de Ciência de Dados e Análise de Negócio, garantindo o acesso a dados de qualidade.

● Implementar e gerenciar soluções de Big Data em ambientes cloud, principalmente em Microsoft Azure (Data Lake, Synapse Analytics).

● Garantir a governança dos dados, aplicando padrões de desenvolvimento, qualidade e segurança.

● Automatizar processos de carga e replicação de dados, incluindo cenários de real-time.

● Colaborar na implementação de esteiras de DevOps (CI/CD) para projetos de Analytics e IA.


Formação e Experiência Mínima

  • Experiência mínima de 6 anos atuando diretamente com Engenharia de Dados ou Business Intelligence.
  • Estabilidade profissional com média de 2 anos nas últimas experiências registradas no currículo.

  • Inglês em nível avançado para leitura técnica e comunicação.


Certificações

  • Obrigatório: Possuir pelo menos uma certificação técnica ativa relacionada à engenharia de dados.
  • Exemplo recomendado: Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203).


Competências Técnicas (Hard Skills):

  • Sólida experiência em ambientes de dados heterogêneos, críticos e com alto volume.
  • Domínio de modelagem de dados multidimensional (star schema) e relacional.
  • SQL em nível avançado para consultas complexas e otimização de performance.
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas de ETL, preferencialmente SSIS, Azure Synapse Pipelines ou Azure Data Factory.
  • Conhecimento em ecossistemas Big Data (ex: Hadoop) e programação em Python para manipulação de dados.
  • Vivência com soluções de BI e visualização, especialmente Power BI.
  • Experiência com a stack de dados da Microsoft Azure: Azure SQL DB, Synapse Analytics (anteriormente SQL DW), Data Lake Store, e noções de Azure Machine Learning


Competências Comportamentais (Soft Skills)

  • Comunicação clara e objetiva para interagir com áreas técnicas e de negócio.
  • Perfil proativo e engajado na resolução de problemas complexos.
  • Capacidade de organização, foco e gestão de prioridades.
  • Atitude colaborativa para trabalhar em equipes multidisciplinares.


Diferenciais (Nice to Have)

description:

One of the largest companies in the world in the Gaming industry is seeking a hands-on Data Architect with DataWarehouse Engineer expertise in Databricks (DBX) and AWS-native data services to spearhead the design and implementation of a new data warehouse instance for a major product line. title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


We are seeking a Full-Stack Data Engineer to join our Mobile Applications department. This is a hybrid role that combines data engineering with data science overlap, giving you full ownership of the data lifecycle — from ingestion to transformation, analysis, and storytelling.

You will build and optimize scalable pipelines, ingest mobile app data from diverse sources, ensure infrastructure reliability, and deliver insights that directly influence how our apps grow. The ideal candidate thrives at the intersection of engineering and analytics, equally capable of writing production-grade pipelines and uncovering meaningful trends in user behavior.


Key Responsibilities


Data Infrastructure & Pipelines

  • Build and maintain scalable, end-to-end pipelines across cloud environments. Ingest and transform data from files, APIs, mobile telemetry (Firebase, Amplitude, Google Analytics), and external databases into centralized stores.
  • Continuously monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize infrastructure for performance, scalability, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Implement data quality monitoring, governance policies, and best practices for privacy, security, and compliance.
  • Participate in technical architecture discussions, contributing expertise on scalable, efficient data systems.


Analytics & Insights

  • Conduct exploratory and advanced analysis using SQL, Python, and statistical methods.
  • Collaborate with Analysts, Data Scientists, and Product Managers to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Support experimentation and A/B testing by ensuring clean, reliable datasets and analyzing results.
  • Deliver actionable recommendations that influence mobile product strategy, user acquisition, and retention.


Collaboration & Best Practices

  • Engage in peer code reviews to uphold high standards of quality and maintainability.
  • Work cross-functionally with software engineering and business teams to ensure data solutions align with company priorities.
  • Document pipelines, workflows, and methodologies to foster reusability and knowledge sharing.


Who You Are


  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 3+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar technical role focused on data infrastructure and pipelines.
  • Strong expertise in SQL and proficiency in Python (or a similar programming language such as Java or C#).
  • Experience with AWS (Redshift, RDS, S3) and Google Cloud (BigQuery, Firebase) for managing cloud-based databases and analytics tools.
  • Familiarity with data pipeline orchestration tools (dbt, Airflow, or similar).
  • Strong knowledge of data warehousing concepts, ELT/ETL best practices, and dimensional modeling. Experience with version control systems (e.g., GitHub).
  • Excellent communicator who can bridge technical depth with clear storytelling for non-technical stakeholders.

title: Senior Power BI Developer with Redshift experience
description:
We are looking for a Senior Power BI Developer for a 100% Remote, 3 month +, 1099 contract


No 3rd Party C2Cs Please.


Location: Brazil, South America (work remote supporting US based client/project)

Employment Type: Contract Work, 40 hours weekly


100% Requirement: Must have good verbal & written communication (English)


Summary:

We are seeking an experienced, highly skilled Power BI Report developer to join our project and play a pivotal role in delivering reports for a new product rollout. You will meet regularly to review progress and adjust report visualizations with key stakeholders.

For this project, you will be developing Power BI reports from hundreds of millions of unaggregated rows of IoT data stored in AWS Redshift. You should be skilled at creating highly optimized aggregate queries with a keen understanding of how to leverage partitioning and indexing.


Responsibilities:

  • Work with stakeholders including the Executive, Product, and Data teams to understand objectives, important metrics, and how they measure business performance.
  • Create visualizations for all parts of the company that empower them to make business decisions.
  • Develop, secure, and maintain data and reporting according to best practices.
  • Account for the accuracy of the data presented to internal customers through the execution of validation processes and testing procedures.
  • Assemble large, complex data sets that meet business requirements.
  • Create and optimize data models to ensure efficient data retrieval and analysis.
  • Investigate and resolve issues in BI tools and reports reported by end users, ensuring accuracy and performance.


Skills & Requirements:

  • 5+ years of advanced Power BI development skills, including data visualization, performance tuning, and UX optimization.
  • Experience with AWS Redshift Database
  • Demonstrated ability to interpret stakeholder requests and translate into actionable insights through analyzing data and preparing insightful reports to drive business decisions
  • Proficiency in data modeling, particularly with star schema designs for reporting and analysis.
  • Expertise in SQL for data preparation, optimization, and transformation, including advanced query techniques like window functions and aggregations.
  • Proficient in DAX for creating calculations, measures, and Calculation Groups in Power BI.
  • Skilled in Power Query and M code for data transformation and troubleshooting.
  • Excellent writing and communication skills for creating clear documentation, collaboration with team members, and troubleshooting with end users.
  • Working knowledge of version control systems, especially git, for managing code and
  • collaboration.
  • Experience in setting up and maintaining local development and testing environments.
  • Basic understanding of data engineering concepts, including ETL processes and data pipelines.
  • Ability to work independently

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
About Turnkey

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software.

The TurnKey team is growing fast and worldwide! We have employees located in Eastern European countries and Latin America (Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, and Uruguay). We continue scaling remote software development teams for more than 30+ US-based enterprises and start-ups, including Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, Ironclad, BellXcel, etc. At TurnKey, we’re the ultimate matchmakers for US-based companies, creating remote dream teams.


Role Overview

We’re looking for a driven and detail-oriented Technical Recruiter to join our growing team. You will play a key role in sourcing and recruiting top tech and non-tech talent across Europe and Latin America , partnering closely with hiring managers and candidates to ensure an excellent recruitment experience from start to finish.


Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with internal teams and clients to understand hiring needs and role requirements
  • Source, screen, and engage candidates for a variety of technical and non-technical roles
  • Manage full-cycle recruitment: job posting, sourcing, screening, coordinating interviews, collecting feedback, and offer negotiation
  • Build and maintain talent pipelines for high-demand positions
  • Ensure a smooth and timely candidate experience, keeping stakeholders informed throughout the process
  • Collaborate with team members and hiring managers to continuously improve processes
  • Maintain accurate data in our applicant tracking systems and internal reports
  • Stay updated on regional hiring trends and market insights across Europe and LATAM


Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in recruiting for both technical and non-technical roles.
  • Strong knowledge of IT roles, technologies, and industry trends.
  • Familiarity with both technical and non-technical profiles
  • Solid sourcing skills and experience with LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, and other sourcing tools
  • Strong communication and organizational skills
  • Experience hiring in Latin America
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, remote-first environment
  • Upper-Intermediate + level of English
  • Readiness to work in various time zones according to the candidates’ time zone


Why You Should Work at TurnKey:

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team.
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks);
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget.
  • Private health insurance.
  • Free advanced English lessons with a budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work;
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes.
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together.
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise.

title: Bolsista Doutor - Tecnospeed -  Reescrita e Modernização de Componentes Críticos dos Produtos - IEL/PR
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses , promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado , ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico , favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico . A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências , e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável .


Sobre a Oportunidade:

Vem transformar com a gente!

A Tecnospeed é uma empresa brasileira especializada em soluções tecnológicas para Desenvolvedores de Software. Referência Nacional em escrituração fiscal e soluções financeiras. Com foco em inovação, governança e inteligência de dados, a Tecnospeed atua como parceira estratégica de empresas privadas e profissionais autônomos, desenvolvendo produtos e serviços que asseguram conformidade com as exigências regulatórias. Ganhadora das Melhores Empresas para Trabalhar no GPTW Nacional e Regional no Setor de Tecnologia. Reconhecida na área de Gestão em Inovação pelo PNI e sempre colocando PESSOAS em primeiro lugar.


Formação Acadêmica:

Doutorado em Doutorado em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia da Computação, Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas


Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.


Projeto: Reescrita e modernização de componentes críticos dos produtos


Principais Atividades:

  • Produzir código limpo, legível, modular e testável , facilitando manutenções futuras e evolução contínua;
  • Reduzir a complexidade técnica e os riscos de regressão;
  • Melhorar o desempenho das aplicações, otimizando respostas e consumo de recursos;
  • Aumentar a confiabilidade e estabilidade dos sistemas por meio de testes automatizados e cobertura robusta ;
  • Integrar ferramentas de inteligência artificial para acelerar a codificação, revisar código e reforçar a qualidade técnica;
  • Promover entregas com ganhos tangíveis de qualidade percebida pelo cliente final ;
  • Estabelecer padrões reutilizáveis de desenvolvimento e construir um legado técnico escalável dentro da empresa.
  • Implemente métricas, logs e rastreamento distribuído.


Conhecimento necessário:

  • Linguagens e Desenvolvimento Backend:
  • Experiência prévia com programação de APIs. Conhecimento em Node.js, Go (Golang) e TypeScript, com foco no desenvolvimento de aplicações performáticas, seguras e escaláveis.


Conhecimento desejável:

  • Inglês técnico (leitura e escrita);
  • Projetos futuros serão desenvolvidos preferencialmente em Node.js e Go, portanto familiaridade com essas tecnologias será considerada um diferencial.


Valor da bolsa (mensal) : Bolsista (Doutor) R$ 5.000 – Programa Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial

Formato de trabalho : Remoto

Soft Skills: Autogestão; Trabalho em equipe; Criatividade; Organização; Ética e responsabilidade.

description:

Com mais de 35 anos de mercado e localizada em 16 países, a GFT emprega mais de 12.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo quase 5.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Profissional de nível Sênior/Especialista que atue com AI/ML.

  • Projetar e implementar soluções complexas, escaláveis e seguras de IA na AWS, adaptadas às necessidades dos clientes

  • Conhecimento prático de IA generativa e experiência com prompt engineering, implantação e hospedagem de large foundational models
  • Experiência com serviços de IA da AWS, como SageMaker, Bedrock e outros serviços de machine learning
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de código em uma ou mais linguagens de programação (Java, JavaScript, Python, etc.)



Desejável:


  • Experiência com uma ampla gama de serviços AWS (por exemplo, EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, IAM, VPC, CloudFormation)
  • Experiência com automação e scripting (por exemplo, Terraform, Python)
  • Certificações AWS (por exemplo, AWS Certified AI Practitioner, AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate, AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate)


Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.

title: Generative AI Engineer
description:
Location: Remote (Applications open worldwide)

Compensation: $20,000 – 40,000 / year (based on experience and scope of ownership)

Skills: Semantic Search, Vector Databases, Prompt Engineering, GenAI Frameworks, React Agents, Graph Agents, Document Parsing, Python, Scalable APIs


About AnswerThis


AnswerThis is an AI-powered research platform built to eliminate the most time-consuming part of academic research: the literature review. We serve researchers globally, from PhD students to academic professionals, helping them go from query to a comprehensive, cited review in minutes.

Our system understands how papers connect, ranks relevance, summarizes insights, and maps citations. This removes weeks of manual work. But that is just the beginning. We are building a vertically integrated AI research suite that streamlines every stage of academic discovery.

If you want to design algorithms that directly accelerate science in medicine, AI, climate, and more, this is the place to do it.


The Role


We are hiring an AI Engineer to lead the development of the core intelligence behind AnswerThis. This role requires deep expertise in information retrieval, scalable backend systems, and generative AI.

You will:

  • Build and optimize semantic search pipelines, graph-based retrieval, and agentic systems.
  • Design and deploy scalable APIs and services capable of serving hundreds of concurrent requests.
  • Architect, implement, and productionize vector databases and embedding-based retrieval systems.
  • Work on GenAI integrations including react agents, graph agents, prompt engineering, and LLM orchestration.
  • Set up full-stack search engines from scratch that can handle real-world academic workloads.
  • Contribute directly to the infrastructure that makes cutting-edge science more efficient.


This is a hands-on role with real ownership. You will move fast, experiment, and ship production systems that impact thousands of researchers worldwide.


Requirements


  • Strong background in semantic search, vector databases, LLM frameworks, agent-based systems, and document retrieval.
  • Skilled in Python for backend development with the ability to build scalable APIs and services.
  • Past experience deploying systems at scale, including search engines, retrieval pipelines, or embedding models.
  • Ability to design infrastructure that serves hundreds of concurrent requests.
  • Experience setting up and hosting APIs with public access while balancing speed, cost, and reliability.
  • A research-driven and pragmatic mindset with a focus on measurable outcomes.


Compensation


$20,000 – 40,000 / year depending on experience, expertise, and scope of ownership. This is a full-time role with significant responsibility and long-term upside.


How to Apply


Send the following to

Subject: AI Engineer Application

Include:

  • Your resume.
  • Details of past projects, especially production-level work with search, retrieval, or GenAI pipelines.
  • A short note on why you want to design algorithms at AnswerThis.


Applications without these will not be considered.

Let us build the future of research together.

title: Professor de francês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?



  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
For many of us, there’s that one podcast we never miss, and video content is part of our daily routine, whether it’s professional or personal. But how many of us truly understand the effort that goes on behind the scenes? Here at Riverside, we know it well. That’s exactly why we built an AI-powered platform that helps content creators, podcasters, marketeers, and more at major brands like Netflix, Disney, Google, and Microsoft to create high-quality content with ease.

Riverside’s technology streamlines the entire content creation process, turning ideas into professional-grade content with the highest production standards, without requiring expensive equipment or external services. The secret? AI-driven tools that replace traditional production roles like editing, directing, and design, automating the entire process at the click of a button.


About the Engineering Team

We’re a team of smart, curious engineers building scalable, reliable systems that power content creation for millions. We work with modern web technologies, tackle real-world challenges in distributed systems, and keep things practical-no over-engineering, just solid solutions. If you love solving tough problems, moving fast, and building tech that creators actually use, you’ll fit right in.


On your day to day

We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer (Remote) who’s passionate about technology, performance, and crafting amazing user experiences. You’ll join a global, distributed team working on the core of our platform - where most of the content of our users is being created, where stability and performance are key.


Tech Stack: TypeScript • React • Redux • Nest.js • Node.js • MongoDB • AWS


What You’ll Do:

  • Build and ship end-to-end features that power our recording & live-call experience
  • Design and maintain scalable microservices
  • Prototype quickly, iterate fast, and deliver impact
  • Collaborate with product, design & growth teams to improve UX
  • Use data to guide decisions and enhance performance

Why You’ll Love It

  • Work with a passionate, remote-first team
  • Shape the product used by thousands of creators
  • Competitive pay + flexibility + autonomy

If you love building seamless, high-performance web experiences - we’d love to meet you.


What Will Make You Stand Out?

  • Degree in Computer Science or equivalent real-world experience
  • 8+ years of software development experience
  • Deep expertise in React and JavaScript/TypeScript , applying modern best practices, design patterns, and clean code principles
  • Good experience with Node.js, MongoDB, and RESTful APIs
  • Proven experience working in remote and distributed teams
  • Excellent communication and teamwork in English
  • Bonus: Experience with Websockets, WebRTC, MediaStream, and browser APIs for audio/video

Bottom line? If you wanna take part in transforming how people and businesses share their stories globally, Riverside’s your place. The work is challenging, the culture is fast-paced, and the people are exceptionally brilliant. And if that’s not enough, we guarantee that your ideas will genuinely make an impact.

title: Control Engineer
description:
Controls Engineer – Sustaining

Remote | Global Support Role | Full-Time

TARGAN


About the Role

TARGAN is transforming animal agriculture through advanced automation — and we’re looking for a Controls Engineer – Sustaining to help keep our systems running smoothly around the world.

This is a hands-on, global support role that bridges Field Services and R&D Controls Engineering . You’ll remotely monitor and troubleshoot our automated machinery at hatcheries across Brazil, Thailand, Italy, Spain , and North America — ensuring uptime, reliability, and continuous improvement of our control systems.


What You’ll Do

  • Remotely monitor TARGAN systems via cloud dashboards, PLC access, and on-machine interfaces .
  • Provide real-time technical support to field technicians via Teams and other communication tools .
  • Analyze hatchery performance data and participate in weekly global team meetings to share insights and best practices.
  • Serve as part of the escalation process when issues impact customer operations, coordinating with internal engineering teams.
  • Support ongoing refinement and optimization of control and electrical systems.


What You Bring

  • Proven ability to troubleshoot PLCs remotely and interpret electrical schematics.
  • Solid understanding of electro-mechanical systems , Ethernet networks , and industrial fieldbus protocols (EtherCAT, Modbus TCP, etc.).
  • Familiarity with industrial control languages (ladder logic, structured text, function block) and HMI systems .
  • Experience with tools such as AutoCAD Electrical or SolidWorks Electrical is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical and field teams.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering, Computer Science , or related field preferred.
  • Fluent in English and at least one of: Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, or Thai .
  • 3–5+ years of experience in engineering support or industrial automation ; equivalent hands-on experience considered.
  • Willingness to work second or third shift (EST) to align with international time zones.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with R&D, Field Services, and Operations teams.


Why TARGAN?

Join a growing global company pioneering automation in animal health and agriculture . At TARGAN, you’ll collaborate with talented engineers across continents, support cutting-edge machinery, and make a direct impact on our customers’ success worldwide. Highly competitive base salary, bonus, benefits and stock options.


*Please note: final salary is dependent upon geographical location, experience and level*

title: Senior Software Architect
description:
About Specialty Capital

Specialty Capital was founded just four years ago with a bold idea - to give “debanked” small businesses access to capital that’s Simple, Smart, and Reliable. Today, the company is among the top revenue-based finance companies in the U.S., serving thousands of merchants through a combination of speed, technology, and a deeply human approach. We’re now entering our next chapter and scaling into new financial verticals (credit cards, payments, and neo-bank integrations) and expanding internationally, starting with Canada. The company is profitable, founder-led, and growing rapidly with a culture built on grit, ownership, and mission.


Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Technical Architect to shape the technological foundation of our rapidly growing small business lending platform. This fully remote position offers the opportunity to design and implement cutting-edge financial technology solutions while working with a dynamic team focused on revolutionizing business financing. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in mobile application development and financial services technology to help us build scalable, secure, and innovative lending solutions.


Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Technical Strategy

  • Design and evolve the comprehensive technical architecture for our lending platform, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security
  • Define and maintain architectural standards, patterns, and best practices across all technology initiatives
  • Lead technology selection and evaluation processes for new tools, frameworks, and platforms
  • Create technical roadmaps aligned with business objectives and product strategy
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to development teams

Mobile Application Architecture

  • Architect and oversee the development of native mobile applications for iOS and Android platforms
  • Design mobile solutions that deliver exceptional user experiences for loan applications and account management
  • Ensure seamless integration between mobile applications and backend services
  • Optimize mobile application performance and offline capabilities


Platform Development

  • Collaborate with SaaS vendors to ensure platform configurations align with architectural standards
  • Design and implement API strategies for internal and external integrations
  • Architect microservices and serverless solutions using cloud services
  • Develop architecture strategies for analytics, reporting, and machine learning
  • Implement AI and automation solutions to streamline lending processes


Security & Compliance

  • Define security architecture and implement defense-in-depth strategies
  • Ensure architectural compliance with financial industry regulations and standards
  • Design secure data handling and encryption strategies for sensitive financial information
  • Lead security reviews and threat modeling exercises
  • Implement monitoring and incident response architectures


Technical Leadership

  • Provide hands-on technical expertise in node.js, React, Swift, Java/Kotlin development
  • Review code, architectures, and technical designs to ensure quality and standards
  • Facilitate technical discussions and decision-making across teams
  • Establish development standards, coding practices, and documentation requirements
  • Drive continuous improvement in development processes and technical practices

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field; Master's degree preferred
  • 10-15 years of progressive experience in software architecture and development
  • Required: Extensive experience in mobile application development for iOS and Android platforms
  • Strong expertise in Swift for iOS and Java/Kotlin for Android development
  • Proven experience with financial technology platforms and payment systems
  • Deep knowledge of cloud architecture
  • Experience with node.js, React, mySQL, and modern web technologies
  • Strong background in API design, microservices, and distributed systems
  • Experience with ETL processes, data pipelines, and reporting solutions
  • Understanding of cybersecurity best practices and financial services regulations
  • Excellent communication skills with ability to translate technical concepts to business stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in small business lending or commercial finance
  • Experience with Large Language Models / ML implementations in financial services
  • Knowledge of loan origination systems and credit decisioning platforms
  • Experience with React Native or cross-platform mobile development frameworks

What We Offer

  • Fully remote position with flexible working arrangements
  • Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience
  • Comprehensive benefits including health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Opportunity to shape the technical direction of a growing fintech company
  • Professional development opportunities and conference attendance
  • Collaborative environment with a focus on innovation and impact

Join Specialty Capital and play a pivotal role in revolutionizing small business lending through innovative technology solutions. As our Technical Architect, you'll have the opportunity to design systems that directly impact thousands of businesses across the country, helping them access the capital they need to grow and thrive.

Specialty Capital is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.

title: Anti-Money Laundering Manager
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain AML/CFT and sanctions policies and procedures aligned with Brazilian regulatory requirements and global best practices.
  • Regulatory interface (inspections, responses, remediation plans)
  • Conduct customer due diligence (CDD/KYC/KYB) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) reviews in accordance with risk-based methodologies.
  • Support ongoing transaction monitoring, screening, and investigation of suspicious activities.
  • Prepare, review, and file Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) and other regulatory filings with COAF or relevant authorities.
  • Monitor developments in AML/CFT and sanctions laws, and assist in updating internal procedures accordingly.
  • Assist in the delivery of internal training and awareness sessions on AML/CFT and sanctions compliance.
  • Conduct periodic risk assessments, ensuring all controls are operating effectively and aligned with the company’s enterprise risk management framework.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails for all compliance reviews, escalations, and filings.
  • Support internal and external audits, as well as inspections or information requests from regulators.
  • Coordinate with Legal, Risk, Operations, and Technology teams to strengthen compliance systems and data integrity.
  • Contribute to the assessment and oversight of third-party vendors that support AML/CFT and compliance operations.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in AML/CFT and sanctions compliance experience in financial, fintech, or VASP sectors.
  • Proven ability to operate independently as part of the second line of defense.
  • Strong understanding of COAF, Central Bank of Brazil, and CVM regulations, as well as FATF standards.
  • Proficient in KYC/KYB, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Economics, or related field; postgraduate or certification (e.g., CAMS, ICA) preferred.
  • Excellent analytical skills, professional integrity, and fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors, including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Front end- React.js PL
description:
Código da vaga: 55307


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

  • Implementar melhores práticas de desenvolvimento de software, incluindo testes automatizados e revisão de código.
  • Participar de reuniões de planejamento e contribuir com ideias para aprimorar o produto.
  • Garantir a compatibilidade entre diferentes navegadores e dispositivos.

Modelo 100% home office

CLT pela BRQ + Pacote de benefícios

Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

title: Mid/Senior Vue.js Software Engineer
description:
Your next opportunity is on the way!


VILT is an IT company where we value our people, promote teamwork, and of course, good humor.


We believe that diversity and inclusion make our team stronger. Everyone is welcome here, and professionals with disabilities are encouraged to apply.

Take a look at this job opportunity and see if you are the next VILTian! (and if you know someone, don’t forget to recommend them)


We’re seeking a Frontend Engineer to help us build intuitive, performant, and modern user experiences with Vue.js and TypeScript . You’ll have the opportunity to work closely with talented engineers and designers, turning ideas into high-quality digital products that impact thousands of users.

What we expect from you :

Mid-level:

  • Strong experience with Vue.js and its ecosystem (Vuex, Vue Router, etc.).
  • Solid knowledge of TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript (ES6+).
  • Experience integrating REST APIs and working with version control (Git).
  • Familiarity with testing frameworks (Playwright).
  • Good English communication skills (written and spoken).


Senior-level:

  • Proven expertise in Vue.js and TypeScript, delivering complex and scalable frontends.
  • Ability to make architectural decisions and lead UI performance improvements.
  • Strong UX awareness and experience collaborating with design teams.
  • Experience mentoring and supporting junior engineers.
  • Good English communication skills (written and spoken).


Additional Information:

  • CLT employment type;
  • Working schedule follows the Portugal time zone.


If you’re ready to take your engineering career to the next level, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Electrical BIM Modeler
description:
Now Hiring: Electrical BIM Modeler

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Engagement Type: Full-Time

Work Format: Work From Home


Note: Interested candidates are invited to submit their resume in English.


At Eracore , we bring innovation and precision to the forefront of electrical construction through advanced BIM modeling. From coordination and prefabrication to detailed shop drawings, we support some of the most complex and high-stakes electrical projects in the United States including Data Centers, Government Facilities, Manufacturing Plants, and cutting-edge Commercial developments.


Backed by a dynamic team of 40+ talented modelers and engineers, Eracore is more than just a workplace its a launchpad for ambitious professionals. We collaborate with top-tier electrical contractors nationwide, offering unparalleled exposure, hands-on experience, and real opportunities for career advancement.


If you're ready to work on game-changing projects, grow alongside a fast-rising company, and be part of shaping the future of electrical construction, Eracore is where your next chapter begins.


Join us and shape the future of the construction industry!


Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a BIM/VDC Specialist at Eracore . The Electrical BIM Modeler will be responsible for creating 3D models and shop drawings to provide clarity and precision during field installations. The role involves utilizing BIM software for visualization and validation of electrical installations.


Qualifications

  • 4-7 Years of Experience with Revit
  • Building Information Modeling (BIM) and Construction Drawings skills
  • Experience with Prefabrication Spool Drawings
  • Experience in working with Mechanical Electrical and Plumbing (MEP) systems
  • Proficiency in Architecture and Modeler software
  • Knowledge of electrical design principles and calculations
  • Ability to interpret and create single line diagrams
  • Experience in load calculations and voltage drop evaluations
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills
  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related field

title: Country Manager (Legal, Brasil)
description:
Hello!



We are looking for an experienced and proactive Country Manager to join our global legal team and lead enforcement efforts in Brazil.


You’ll work closely with global legal and business teams, directly protecting the rights of some of the world's most recognized brands.


This is a role with complete ownership for driving our expansion in Brazil.


We need a manager with a legal background who knows how to create processes from scratch in a startup environment, rather than an established corporation. The ideal candidate will effectively lead people, design and scale operations, and be highly results-driven.


Who are we?



BrandMonitor is a global legal-tech company focused on the protection of intellectual property rights across the world. We proudly represent over 450 international brands across industries like fashion, luxury goods, electronics, and more — in their fight against counterfeiting and IP violations.

Our legal operations span Europe, Asia, MENA and Latin America , and we are now expanding our legal team in China .



What you will do:



  • Be responsible for meeting the revenue plan and the target number of enforcement actions (purchases, claims, and lawsuits);
  • Achieve operational profitability for the project;
  • Rebuild the team, organize rapid onboarding, and ensure the team achieves target performance indicators;
  • Develop operational and hiring regulations for project scaling (increasing the number of protected brands, successful cases, and compensation amounts);
  • Negotiate with counterfeit sellers and ensure compliance with settlement agreements and court decisions;
  • Organize regular, predictable seizures of counterfeit goods with law enforcement agencies in the region;
  • Ensure the legality of all activities and provide accurate reporting to the government and the head office.



What we expect from you:


  • Degree in Law / Experience in a management position at a law firm;
  • Project management experience 2-3 years;
  • Experience in building processes from scratch;
  • Knowledge of Intellectual Property - an advantage;
  • Leadership, responsibility, decision-making ability, multitasking skills;
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English B2.



What We Offer


  • Work with top-tier global clients and international teams;
  • Competitive salary;
  • Opportunity to lead and shape legal operations in the region;
  • Remote-first setup with flexibility;
  • Real impact on the global fight against counterfeit trade.
  • We’re building the future of IP protection — fast, smart and global.



Join us at BrandMonitor and help us grow stronger by hiring the people who’ll make it happen.

title: Desenvolvedor de firmware
description:
Desenvolvedor de Firmware | CLT | 100% Remota


Sobre nós e Resumo da posição

A Control iD é uma indústria brasileira, especializada no desenvolvimento de relógio de ponto, controle de acesso e equipamentos para automação comercial.

Aqui você terá a chance de criar soluções que conectam +300 mil dispositivos IoT e impactam +1 milhão de usuários ativos, em um ambiente que valoriza inovação e liberdade tecnológica.


O que buscamos:

  • Forte experiência em C++ e sistemas embutidos/embarcados;
  • Vivência com Linux ;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas embarcados ;
  • Experiência em otimização de performance, consumo e recursos de hardware;
  • Familiaridade com protocolos de comunicação (UART, SPI, I2C, TCP/IP, etc.);
  • Boas práticas de segurança e qualidade de código;
  • Atuação em metodologias ágeis.


Seu papel será:

Participar de todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento de firmware — desde a concepção, arquitetura, implementação até os testes — sempre com foco em segurança, performance e escalabilidade para produtos conectados.


Diferenciais da vaga:

  • 100% remoto;
  • VR sem desconto em folha;
  • Convênio médico com coparticipação apenas quando usar;
  • PLR + Seguro de Vida;
  • Totalpass;
  • Participação prática nos produtos desenvolvidos pela empresa.

title: Engenheiro de Software (Java) (Exclusiva para Pessoa com Deficiência)
description:
Estamos contratando um(a) Software Engineer Mid Level para integrar o Billing Team no Brasil.


Este time é responsável por toda a plataforma que processa vendas, renovações de assinaturas e fluxos de receita, criando registros de recebíveis de clientes, além de gerenciar processos de cobrança (dunning).


As soluções desenvolvidas envolvem integrações globais com motores de cálculo de impostos, respeitando as complexidades de cada mercado, bem como a geração e envio de documentos fiscais às autoridades locais. O time também processa eventos de diversas fontes, transformando-os em lançamentos contábeis integrados ao ERP da empresa.


Seu impacto


Executar projetos estratégicos junto a um time de engenheiros(as) de software altamente qualificado;

Desenvolver soluções que suportam o processo de revenue recognition e contabilidade global da Wellhub;

Trabalhar em conjunto com um time de ~9 engenheiros(as) mid/sênior, implementando, testando e entregando soluções;

Atuar de forma hands-on, com foco em qualidade e escalabilidade;

Participar de melhorias em serviços existentes, como billing calculate e bill orchestrate, além de iniciativas voltadas para usuário e assinaturas



✅ Quem é você


Formação em Ciência da Computação ou experiência equivalente;

Experiência em engenharia de software, com histórico de entregas de qualidade;

Experiência em Java/Kotlin + Spring (RESTful APIs);

Conhecimentos em SQL (PostgreSQL) e NoSQL (DynamoDB);

Experiência com arquitetura de microsserviços e entendimento de escalabilidade;

Interesse em aprender mais sobre arquiteturas orientadas a eventos e Serverless;

Conhecimento em Cloud Computing (AWS) e Cloud Native (Kubernetes);

Inglês intermediário (essencial para documentação, comentários e comunicação interna), com abertura para evoluir

title: Change Management Leader
description:
Vaga: Líder de Treinamento LATAM


Local: São Paulo, 2x presencial e com possibilidade de viagens pela América Latina


Empresa: A Inetum é uma empresa líder global em serviços de TI, dedicada a fornecer soluções inovadoras aos nossos clientes. Estamos comprometidos em promover um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico, inclusivo e que preza pela diversidade, onde a criatividade e a colaboração prosperem. Estamos presentes em 19 países e somos mais de 28.000 colaboradores no mundo.

Se você está em busca de uma empresa dinâmica, inovadora e tecnológica , a Inetum é o seu lugar! Vem ser Inetum !


Projeto: Salesforce Broker Cloud


Visão Geral


Estamos em busca de um(a) Líder de Treinamento LATAM para atuar no desenvolvimento e execução de conteúdos de capacitação em português para o projeto Salesforce Broker Cloud. Essa posição será responsável por criar um plano de treinamento local alinhado à estratégia global, desenvolver materiais, conduzir sessões de capacitação de multiplicadores e colaborar diretamente com o líder global sediado nos EUA.


Principais Responsabilidades


1. Desenvolvimento do Plano de Treinamento Localizado

  • Criar plano de treinamento adaptado às necessidades dos usuários LATAM
  • Desenvolver conteúdos para até cinco perfis de usuários
  • Avaliar necessidades de capacitação e alinhar com o líder global


2. Criação e Revisão de Conteúdo de Treinamento

  • Produzir e revisar materiais em português para a equipe do cliente
  • Utilizar ferramentas definidas pelo cliente (ex.: WalkMe, Captivate, Camtasia)
  • Garantir que o conteúdo seja envolvente, eficaz e alinhado às atividades no Salesforce


3. Condução de Sessões Train-the-Trainer

  • Liderar sessões de capacitação para multiplicadores locais da AJG
  • Avaliar prontidão dos treinadores e preencher lacunas identificadas


4. Coordenação com o Líder Global (EUA)

  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com o líder global para garantir alinhamento estratégico
  • Localizar e executar estratégias globais conforme as necessidades regionais


5. Transição da entrega de treinamento para os multiplicadores da AJG

  • Apoiar a continuidade dos treinamentos nas fases de rollout


✅ Qualificações


  • Experiência comprovada em projetos de treinamento, preferencialmente com Salesforce
  • Habilidades sólidas de comunicação e criação de conteúdo
  • Capacidade de conduzir avaliações de prontidão e liderar sessões de treinamento
  • Fluência em português e proficiência em inglês ou espanhol
  • Excelentes habilidades organizacionais e de gestão de projetos


Informações Adicionais

  • Colaboração frequente com o líder global sediado nos EUA
  • Possibilidade de viagens dentro da América Latina
  • Papel estratégico na adoção bem-sucedida do Salesforce Broker Cloud pelos usuários locais.

title: Diretor de vendas
description:
Summary


At Hyatt Place São José do Rio Preto, we believe that hospitality is more than a service — it’s a way of connecting people and creating meaningful experiences. Guided by the Hyatt purpose “to care for people so they can be their best,” we are committed to fostering a culture where passion, integrity, and empathy drive everything we do.

We are looking for a Director of Sales with a strategic mindset, exceptional leadership, and strong business acumen to elevate our commercial performance, strengthen our market presence, and lead the brand’s commercial transformation in the region.

This is a unique opportunity for a visionary professional who thrives on challenges, inspires high-performing teams, and builds long-lasting relationships with stakeholders, corporate clients, and investors.

At Hyatt, we value our people as our greatest strength — offering a supportive environment that encourages growth, innovation, and balance . Here, your career goes beyond a job: it becomes a journey of learning, purpose, and global impact.


Qualifications


  • Education : Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Hospitality Management, Marketing, or related field required. A postgraduate degree (MBA or equivalent) will be considered a strong asset.
  • Language : Fluency in English and Portuguese is essential (both written and spoken). Additional languages will be considered a plus.
  • Experience : Experience in Sales leadership roles within the hospitality industry, preferably in international hotel brands.
  • Proven track record of driving commercial results, managing P&L structures, and leading high-performing sales teams.
  • Strong background in strategic account management, business development, and multichannel sales strategy.
  • Advanced knowledge of hotel revenue management, market segmentation, and commercial analytics.
  • Excellent executive communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to inspire teams, foster collaboration, and lead organizational change with resilience and empathy.
  • Proficiency in MS Office, CRM systems, and business intelligence tools (Hyatt systems experience is an advantage).

title: Control Engineer

About the Role

TARGAN is transforming animal agriculture through advanced automation — and we’re looking for a Controls Engineer – Sustaining to help keep our systems running smoothly around the world.

This is a hands-on, global support role that bridges Field Services and R&D Controls Engineering . You’ll remotely monitor and troubleshoot our automated machinery at hatcheries across Brazil, Thailand, Italy, Spain , and North America — ensuring uptime, reliability, and continuous improvement of our control systems.


What You’ll Do

  • Remotely monitor TARGAN systems via cloud dashboards, PLC access, and on-machine interfaces .

  • Serve as part of the escalation process when issues impact customer operations, coordinating with internal engineering teams.
  • Support ongoing refinement and optimization of control and electrical systems.


What You Bring

  • Proven ability to troubleshoot PLCs remotely and interpret electrical schematics.
  • Solid understanding of electro-mechanical systems , Ethernet networks , and industrial fieldbus protocols (EtherCAT, Modbus TCP, etc.).
  • Familiarity with industrial control languages (ladder logic, structured text, function block) and HMI systems .
  • Experience with tools such as AutoCAD Electrical or SolidWorks Electrical is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical and field teams.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering, Computer Science , or related field preferred.
  • Fluent in English and at least one of: Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, or Thai .
  • 3–5+ years of experience in engineering support or industrial automation ; equivalent hands-on experience considered.
  • Willingness to work second or third shift (EST) to align with international time zones.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with R&D, Field Services, and Operations teams.


Why TARGAN?

Join a growing global company pioneering automation in animal health and agriculture . At TARGAN, you’ll collaborate with talented engineers across continents, support cutting-edge machinery, and make a direct impact on our customers’ success worldwide. Highly competitive base salary, bonus, benefits and stock options.


*Please note: final salary is dependent upon geographical location, experience and level*

  • Understanding of "configuration as a code"
  • Experience with containers (docker/podman) and GIT.
  • Bachelor degree in Computer Sciences or related STEM fields.
